拒绝访问：受限环境中编码智能体的分级策略评估Permission Denied: Policy-Graded Evaluation of Coding Agents in Hardened Environments

摘要Abstract

编码智能体越来越多地运行于组织内部，受到权限范围受限的凭据、受限的出站网络、只读文件系统、非 root 执行等安全控制的约束，就像其他软件一样。然而，现有基准几乎只在宽松沙箱中评估智能体，因此在强制执行策略时性能会如何变化仍不得而知。本文在 Terminal-Bench 2.1 上评估 12 种编码智能体，覆盖源自常见现实企业限制的嵌套安全策略级别。加固始终有代价，但影响并不一致：在最严格策略下，成功率损失最高达 18.3 个百分点，成本膨胀最高达 167.3%，而两个维度的变化并不一致；最能保持成功率的模型，同时也是效率损失最大的模型，因此模型选择取决于策略。除汇总分数外，我们还刻画了策略阻止其动作时智能体的行为，并分解加固导致的失败：运行会因超时或错误解而持续耗尽资源，而非提前停止；失败组成因模型而异。为使比较有依据，我们确认任务在最严格策略下是否可解，从而区分模型失败和策略直接排除的任务。我们发布开源加固插件 Boundary-Bench，以便在 Terminal-Bench 及兼容基准上对受策略约束的编码智能体进行评估。

Coding agents increasingly run inside organizations whose security controls (scoped credentials, restricted egress, read-only filesystems, non-root execution) constrain them like any other software. Existing benchmarks, however, evaluate agents almost exclusively in permissive sandboxes, so it is unknown how performance changes when policy is enforced. In this work, we evaluate 12 coding agents on Terminal-Bench 2.1 across nested security policy levels derived from common real-world enterprise restrictions. Hardening is never free but far from uniform: under the strictest policy, success losses reach 18.3 points and cost inflation 167.3%, and the two axes disagree; the model that best preserves success is also the one that loses the most efficiency, so model choice is policy-dependent. Beyond aggregate scores, we characterize how agents behave when policy blocks their actions and decompose the failures hardening induces: runs grind into timeouts or wrong solutions rather than stopping early, in a mix that differs by model. To ground comparisons, we verify task solvability under the strictest policy, separating model failures from tasks the policy forecloses. We release Boundary-Bench, an open-source hardening plugin enabling policy-constrained evaluation of coding agents on Terminal-Bench and compatible benchmarks.

引言Introduction

各组织越来越多地将编码智能体用于软件开发，但这些智能体与用户一样，也受安全控制约束（South et al., 2025）。这类控制并非专为智能体设计：受限凭据、网络限制、受保护路径和有限的管理权限，会约束在环境中运行的任何软件。这些机制对应于 NIST SP 800-53 中的访问控制与边界保护控制族（Joint Task Force Interagency Working Group, 2020）。我们将这类设置称为「加固环境」：由策略限制智能体能够观察、访问或执行内容的执行环境。加固也正逐渐靠近智能体本身，因为当代智能体运行框架提供了网络访问模式、文件系统沙箱和运行配置等控制。¹

Organizations increasingly use coding agents for software development, but these agents operate within security controls that govern users and agents alike (South et al. 2025). Such controls are not agent-specific: scoped credentials, network restrictions, protected paths, and limited administrative privileges constrain any software operating in the environment. These mechanisms correspond to access-control and boundary-protection families in NIST SP 800-53 (Joint Task Force Interagency Working Group 2020). We call such settings hardened environments: execution environments in which policy restricts what an agent can observe, access, or execute. Hardening is also moving closer to the agent itself, as contemporary agent harnesses expose controls such as network access modes, filesystem sandboxes, and run profiles.1官方工具文档：Claude Code、Codex 和 Cursor 的运行模式与权限设置。1 1 Official tool documentation: Claude Code https://code.claude.com/docs/en/claude-code-on-the-web, Codex https://developers.openai.com/codex/permissions, Cursor https://cursor.com/docs/agent/run-modes.

一些编码智能体基准使用宽松的任务沙箱：Terminal-Bench 允许智能体自由操作任务容器（Merrill et al., 2026），FeatureBench 提供不受限的互联网访问（Zhou et al., 2026），而企业数据隐私与访问控制策略很少在标准基准中接受测试（Yehudai et al., 2026）。类似于会扰乱智能体并迫使其重新规划的中途工具故障与禁用情形（Xiong et al., 2025；Liu et al., 2026），策略拒绝可能引发重试、变通或放弃；我们用成功率—成本帕累托前沿表示由此产生的权衡（Kapoor et al., 2025）。AgentHarm 等安全评估记录了促使组织实施这些限制的风险（Andriushchenko et al., 2024），但不衡量执行限制会使成功率和 token 支出付出多少代价。按合规性评分的基准会检查智能体是否遵守明示策略，但既不在运行时强制执行策略，也不衡量其运行成本（Levy et al., 2026）。安全策略执行本身是一种结构化的运行时扰动：不同于观察干扰或注入故障（Ma et al., 2024；Kara, Faisal, and Nath, 2025），它会改变哪些观察和动作是被允许的。因此，现有评估无法说明随着策略收紧，编码智能体的表现会如何变化；在宽松环境下形成的排行榜也可能错误呈现智能体在已部署企业环境中的成功率—成本权衡。

Some coding-agent benchmarks use permissive task sandboxes: Terminal-Bench allows agents to manipulate task containers freely (Merrill et al. 2026), FeatureBench provides free Internet access (Zhou et al. 2026), and enterprise data-privacy and access-control policies are rarely tested in standard benchmarks (Yehudai et al. 2026). Like the mid-trajectory tool failures and bans that destabilize agents and require replanning (Xiong et al. 2025; Liu et al. 2026), a policy denial can trigger retries, workarounds, or abandonment; we represent the resulting trade-off as a success–cost Pareto frontier (Kapoor et al. 2025). Safety evaluations such as AgentHarm document the risks that motivate such restrictions (Andriushchenko et al. 2024), but do not measure what enforcing them costs in success rate and token spend. Compliance-scored benchmarks check whether agents follow stated policies, but neither enforce them at runtime nor measure their operational cost (Levy et al. 2026). Security-policy enforcement is itself a structured runtime perturbation: unlike observation distractions or injected faults (Ma et al. 2024; Kara, Faisal, and Nath 2025), it changes which observations and actions are permitted. Existing evaluations therefore do not show how coding-agent performance changes as such policies tighten, and unconstrained leaderboards may misrepresent the success–cost trade-offs of agents in deployed enterprise settings.

本文表明，加固并不会以一致方式降低编码智能体的表现。策略约束会使每个模型的成功率—成本工作点在两个维度上都恶化，但各模型恶化的幅度和承担代价的形式不同，从而改变帕累托前沿，并使模型选择取决于策略。这个影响来自行为差异：智能体面对被拒绝的动作时反应不同（有些重试，有些改走其他路径，有些则放弃），因此无法根据无约束环境下的分数预测强制执行策略时的表现。单一的锁定配置只提供一个工作点，无法显示策略逐渐收紧时前沿如何移动。因此，我们提出 Boundary-Bench，并在一系列分级、嵌套的策略级别下评估智能体。这些级别源自常见企业限制设置，并映射到 NIST SP 800-53 控制。每个级别中，我们都在 Terminal-Bench 上运行各模型原生的智能体运行框架。我们报告完整任务集上的结果。作为次要诊断，我们跟踪是否有任何受测智能体能够解决每项任务（任务可达性），以及参考解在各策略级别下是否仍然兼容。我们的贡献如下：

In this paper, we show that hardening does not uniformly degrade coding-agent performance. Every model’s success–cost operating point worsens on both axes under policy, but by amounts and in currencies that differ across models, reshaping the Pareto frontier and making model choice policy-dependent. This effect is behavioral: agents respond differently to denied actions (some retry, some reroute, and some give up), so performance under enforced policy cannot be predicted from unconstrained scores. Because a single locked-down configuration provides only one operating point, it cannot show how the frontier moves as policies tighten. We therefore introduce Boundary-Bench and evaluate agents under graded, nested policy levels derived from common enterprise restriction settings and mapped to NIST SP 800-53 controls. At each level, we run each model’s native harness on Terminal-Bench. We report outcomes over the full task set. As secondary diagnostics, we track whether any evaluated agent solves each task (task accessibility) and whether its reference solution remains compatible with each policy level. Our contributions are:

  • •

    策略分级评估。我们发布开源加固插件 Boundary-Bench，使每个模型在其原生运行框架中运行 Terminal-Bench 2.1，并由原生 Linux 机制强制执行三个相互嵌套的策略级别。

    Policy-graded evaluation. We release Boundary-Bench as an open-source hardening plugin that runs each model in its native harness on Terminal-Bench 2.1 under three nested policy levels enforced by native Linux mechanisms.

  • •

    任务诊断。我们报告所有 Terminal-Bench 任务上的结果。作为次要诊断，我们跟踪是否有任何受测智能体能够解决每项任务，以及其参考解在策略下是否仍然兼容。这可以识别任务可达性，以及规范轨迹受阻时智能体通过其他轨迹成功的情况。

    Task diagnostics. We report outcomes over all Terminal-Bench tasks. As secondary diagnostics, we track whether any evaluated agent solves each task and whether its reference solution remains compatible under the policy. This identifies task accessibility and cases where agents succeed through alternative trajectories when the canonical trajectory is blocked.

  • •

    非均一的策略影响。我们表明，加固对每个模型—运行框架组合的影响并不一致：有些模型成功率下降，有些模型 token 成本上升，有些两者兼有，因而在每个策略级别上都会改变成功率—成本帕累托前沿（图 1、图 2）。

    Non-uniform policy effects. We show that hardening degrades every model–harness bundle non-uniformly: some models lose success, some incur higher token cost, and some experience both, reshaping the success–cost Pareto frontier at each policy level (Figure 1, Figure 2).

  • •

    失败模式分解。我们把策略导致的性能下降分解为实测失败模式：新增失败主要来自预算耗尽以及已经完成但答案错误的情况；两者比例因组合而异。我们还量化智能体在执行边界遭遇阻断动作的情况（表 3）。

    Failure-mode decomposition. We decompose policy-induced degradation into measured failure modes: the extra failures are dominated by budget exhaustion and completed-but-wrong solutions, in proportions that differ by bundle, and we quantify agents’ blocked-action exposure at the enforcement boundary (Table 3).

相关工作Related Work

SWE-bench（Jimenez et al., 2023）标准化了仓库级编码评估；Terminal-Bench（Merrill et al., 2026）和 OSWorld（Xie et al., 2024）评估交互式编码与计算机使用智能体；考虑成本的评估会将成功率与推理成本一同报告，例如用帕累托前沿表示（Kapoor et al., 2025）。这些工作都固定执行安全配置，而没有将其作为评估因素加以变化。验证器过度规格化——断言要求了任务本身并不需要的附带细节——也是已记录的代码生成基准失效模式（Sharifloo et al., 2025）；我们在比较策略前审查并修复了五个此类验证器。路由与级联方法（Chen, Zaharia, and Zou, 2024；Ong et al., 2024）通过改变模型选择来权衡性能与成本；我们保留双目标框架，以验证器检查过的任务成功作为结果，并将环境策略级别设为自变量。

SWE-bench (Jimenez et al. 2023) standardizes repository-level coding evaluation; Terminal-Bench (Merrill et al. 2026) and OSWorld (Xie et al. 2024) evaluate interactive coding and computer-use agents; cost-aware evaluation reports success jointly with inference cost, for example as a Pareto frontier (Kapoor et al. 2025). All hold the execution-security configuration fixed rather than varying it as an evaluation factor. Verifier over-specification, where assertions demand incidental details a task never requires, is likewise a documented failure mode of code-generation benchmarks (Sharifloo et al. 2025); we audit and repair five such verifiers before any policy comparison. Routing and cascade methods (Chen, Zaharia, and Zou 2024; Ong et al. 2024) navigate a performance–cost trade-off by varying model choice; we keep the two-objective framing, use verifier-checked task success as the outcome, and make the environment’s policy level the independent variable.

AgentHarm 在恶意任务上评估有害性与拒绝行为（Andriushchenko et al., 2024）；ToolEmu 在由语言模型模拟的沙箱中揭示高风险工具使用行为（Ruan et al., 2023）；ST-WebAgentBench 事后依据组织策略对网页智能体轨迹评分（Levy et al., 2026）；τ-bench 在提示中给出领域规则，但只强制执行基本有效性检查（Yao et al., 2024）；AgentDyn 表明，低攻击成功率的提示注入防御可能同时伴随严重的过度防御和任务效用下降（Li et al., 2026）。与此不同，我们把合规性作为执行环境的一项分级属性施加，并衡量任务成功率和 token 支出如何随策略级别变化。

AgentHarm scores harmfulness and refusal on malicious tasks (Andriushchenko et al. 2024); ToolEmu surfaces risky tool-use behavior in an LM-emulated sandbox (Ruan et al. 2023); ST-WebAgentBench scores web-agent trajectories against organizational policies post hoc (Levy et al. 2026); τ\tau-bench states domain rules in the prompt while enforcing only basic validity checks (Yao et al. 2024); AgentDyn shows that prompt-injection defenses with low attack success can coincide with severe over-defense and reduced task utility (Li et al. 2026). In contrast, we impose compliance as a graded property of the execution environment and measure task success and token spend as functions of the policy level.

输入扰动鲁棒性研究会改变对抗性文本和提示（Wang et al., 2021；Zhu et al., 2023）；ReliabilityBench 改变每次工具调用中注入故障的强度（Gupta, 2026）；WAREX 将网络和服务器故障注入网页智能体轨迹（Kara, Faisal, and Nath, 2025）。我们从有效鲁棒性视角获得定性启发（Taori et al., 2020），比较加固与未加固时的表现。这些工作扰动输入或注入合成故障，而我们的严重性维度就是安全策略本身，且在每次评估运行中保持固定。

Input-perturbation robustness studies adversarial text and prompts (Wang et al. 2021; Zhu et al. 2023); ReliabilityBench varies injected fault intensity per tool call (Gupta 2026); WAREX injects network and server faults into web-agent trajectories (Kara, Faisal, and Nath 2025). We draw qualitative inspiration from the effective-robustness lens (Taori et al. 2020), comparing hardened against unhardened performance. Whereas these works perturb inputs or inject synthetic faults, our severity axis is the security policy itself, held fixed per evaluation run.

沙箱和智能体运行时控制构成了加固执行环境；最接近的先前工作表明，在单一固定配置下，强制执行并不必然摧毁效用。CaMeL 以确定性方式强制执行固定安全策略，并报告强制执行下的任务效用：成功率出现多个百分点的下降，token 开销达到 2.8 倍（Debenedetti et al., 2025）。Progent 强制执行工具调用权限策略，并报告效用基本得以维持（Shi et al., 2025）。Verifier Tax 量化了内部拦截并修正机制下的任务成功率、LLM 调用和 token 开销（Sah et al., 2026）。这些研究各自在单一强制配置下核算代价。我们补充这些单点结果，并据我们所知，首次将策略严重性设为自变量开展基准研究：在模型—运行框架组合之间采用共享、映射到 NIST 且相互嵌套的策略阶梯，并以相同方式运行，衡量强制执行的代价、受影响的组合以及代价体现在哪个维度（成功率或支出），同时报告各级别的任务可达性。

Sandboxes and agent-runtime controls instantiate hardened execution environments, and the closest prior work shows that enforcement need not destroy utility at a single, fixed configuration. CaMeL deterministically enforces a fixed security policy and reports task utility under enforcement: a multi-point success drop and a 2.8×2.8\times token overhead (Debenedetti et al. 2025). Progent enforces tool-call privilege policies and reports utility largely maintained (Shi et al. 2025). The Verifier Tax quantifies task success and LLM-call and token overhead under an internal block-and-revise gate (Sah et al. 2026). Each prices one enforcement configuration in isolation. We complement these single-point results with, to our knowledge, the first benchmark study to make policy severity the independent variable: a shared, NIST-mapped, nested ladder run identically across model–harness bundles, measuring what enforcement costs, for which bundle, and in which currency (success or spend), together with task accessibility at each level.

Boundary-BenchBoundary-Bench

Boundary-Bench 是一个框架，可将可配置、由操作系统强制执行的策略叠加到现有编码智能体基准上，并衡量相对于不受限制基线，智能体成功率和成本如何变化。

Boundary-Bench is a framework that layers a configurable, operating-system-enforced policy onto an existing coding-agent benchmark and measures how agent success and cost change relative to the unrestricted baseline.

策略强制执行Policy Enforcement

策略是一组针对运行时能力的限制，由环境而非智能体强制执行；它限制任何进程能够执行的操作。

A policy is a set of capability restrictions on the runtime, enforced on the environment rather than the agent; it limits what any process can do.

我们用三个维度对策略建模：网络出站访问（N）、文件系统范围（F）和权限（P）。每个维度有三种状态：开放（无限制）、受限和锁定。这三个维度分别映射到 NIST SP 800-53 的不同控制族（Joint Task Force Interagency Working Group, 2020）：网络维度对应边界保护（SC-7）；文件系统维度对应访问、信息流和进程隔离控制（AC-3、AC-4、SC-39）；权限维度对应最小权限（AC-6）。此映射记录了启发各项机制的控制，并不构成合规性声明。

We model policies on three axes: network egress (N), filesystem scope (F), and privilege (P). Each axis ranges over three postures: open (no restrictions), restricted, and locked. The three axes map to distinct families of NIST SP 800-53 controls (Joint Task Force Interagency Working Group 2020): boundary protection (SC-7) on the network axis, access, information-flow, and process-isolation controls (AC-3, AC-4, SC-39) on the filesystem axis, and least privilege (AC-6) on the privilege axis. The mapping records the controls that motivated each mechanism and is not a compliance claim.

我们从这一空间中评估三个策略级别，构成逐步加严的阶梯，每一级都在前一级基础上增加限制。Control 是开放基线：智能体以 root 身份运行，具有不受限的出站访问和可写文件系统。Non-root 只撤销 root 权限，以隔离普通用户身份运行的影响，同时保持网络和文件系统访问开放。NIST-derived high 同时限制全部三个维度：固定的网络出站白名单、除专用小型可写区域外均为只读的文件系统，以及全面的权限锁定。由于从 non-root 到 NIST-derived high 的变化同时涉及多个方面，我们将其影响视为整体配置的效果，而不归因于任何单一维度。完整的出站白名单、只读系统目录、权限锁定，以及各维度对应的 NIST 控制见附录 A。

From this space we evaluate three policy levels that form a cumulative severity ladder, each adding restrictions on top of the previous level. Control is the open baseline: the agent runs as root with unrestricted egress and a writable filesystem. Non-root drops root privilege only, isolating the effect of running as an ordinary user while network and filesystem access stay open. NIST-derived high restricts all three axes together: a fixed network egress allow-list, a read-only filesystem outside a dedicated small writable set, and a full privilege lockdown. Because the step from non-root to NIST-derived high changes several surfaces at once, we treat its effect as whole-configuration rather than attributing it to any single axis. The exact egress allow-list, the read-only system directories, the privilege lockdown, and each axis’s NIST control mapping are given in Appendix A.

每项限制都通过原生 Linux 访问控制机制实现，而不是要求智能体自行遵守：网络出站流量经过智能体无法重新配置的代理；除小型可写工作区外，文件系统均以只读方式挂载；智能体进程以无法再次提权的非特权用户运行。执行机制在环境中编译，不让智能体知晓。智能体遇到的限制只表现为原生运行时错误。智能体创建的每个子进程都会继承所有限制，因此不能通过启动子进程绕过限制；基准设置和评分则在沙箱之外运行。每次运行前，预检探针都会确认所有限制均已启用，否则将以失败关闭方式中止（附录 A）。

Each restriction is realized by a native Linux access-control mechanism rather than requested of the agent: network egress passes through a proxy the agent cannot reconfigure, the filesystem is mounted read-only outside a small writable workspace, and the agent process runs under an unprivileged user that cannot re-escalate. Enforcement is compiled into the environment without the agent’s knowledge. The agent meets each limit only as a native runtime failure. Every restriction is inherited by each child process the agent spawns, so it cannot be evaded by launching a subprocess, while benchmark setup and grading run outside the sandbox. Before each run, pre-flight probes confirm every restriction is active and fail closed otherwise (Appendix A).

基准审计Benchmark Audit

严格策略可能使任务失效，而不只是增加难度，因此 Boundary-Bench 会先在最严格策略下审计基准，再解释任何智能体结果。首先，我们确认每项任务是否可解：在 NIST-derived high 下重放基准自带的参考解；若其不再通过，则尝试自行编写符合策略的参考解。只要通过任一路径达到任务官方通过状态，该任务就获得一个可解性见证。若策略禁止了任务本身所要求的动作，使得不存在符合策略的解，则称该任务在设计上受阻。其次，我们审查所有验证器报告失败、但智能体已达到明示目标的试验，并检查失败断言是否过度规格化；修复只能以添加方式放宽断言，修复后的验证器在所有策略级别下完全相同，同时保留原始结果供审计。第三，我们根据失败运行相对于任务墙钟预算的终止位置进行分类：智能体运行时达到预算的 95% 即为超时；若在该任务运行时长的最低十分位内结束，则为提前停止；其他失败都属于错误解。少量提供方或验证器侧错误会被排除。

A sufficiently strict policy can invalidate a task rather than merely harden it, so Boundary-Bench audits the benchmark under its strictest policy before interpreting any agent result. First, we establish each task’s solvability: we replay the benchmark’s own reference solution under NIST-derived high, and where it no longer passes we attempt to author a policy-compliant reference solution ourselves; a task whose official passing state is reached by either route gains a solvability witness. A task is blocked by design when the policy forbids an action the task itself requires, so no policy-compliant solution exists. Second, we review every trial in which the verifier reported failure although the agent had reached the stated goal, checking the failing assertion for over-specification; a repair may only additively broaden an assertion, and the repaired verifier runs identically at every policy level, with original outcomes kept for audit. Third, we classify every failed run by where it terminates relative to its task’s wall-clock budget: a run whose agent runtime reaches 95% of the budget is a timeout, one that ends in the bottom decile of the task’s runtimes is an early stop, and any other failure is a wrong solution; a small residual of provider- and verifier-side errors is excluded.

实验设置Experimental Setup

所有实验的评估单位都是冻结的模型—运行框架组合，即一个模型及运行它的智能体框架。十二个模型分别是 GPT-5.6 Sol、GPT-5.6 Terra 和 GPT-5.6 Luna（OpenAI）；Claude Sonnet 5、Claude Opus 4.8、Claude Fable 5 和 Claude Opus 5（Anthropic）；Kimi K3、GLM-5.2、Qwen3.7 Max 和 MiniMax M3；以及 Grok 4.5（xAI）。主要比较中，Anthropic 模型使用 Claude Code，OpenAI 模型使用 Codex，Grok 4.5 使用 Grok Build，其余模型使用 Terminus-2。所有组合均使用 high 推理强度，在每种策略配置下评估全部 89 项任务，并且每个组合—任务—策略单元恰有三次有效试验。

The evaluated unit in all experiments is a frozen model-harness bundle: which defines a model and the agent harness that runs it. The twelve models are GPT-5.6 Sol, GPT-5.6 Terra, and GPT-5.6 Luna (OpenAI); Claude Sonnet 5, Claude Opus 4.8, Claude Fable 5, and Claude Opus 5 (Anthropic); Kimi K3, GLM-5.2, Qwen3.7 Max, and MiniMax M3; and Grok 4.5 (xAI). In the primary comparison, Anthropic models use Claude Code, OpenAI models use Codex, Grok 4.5 uses Grok Build, and the remaining models use Terminus-2. All bundles use high effort and are evaluated on all 89 tasks under every policy configuration, with exactly three valid trials per bundle-task-policy cell.

Claude Fable 5 配备了双用途安全分类器；Anthropic 的默认行为会将被标记的请求改由 Claude Opus 4.8 响应。我们保留这一默认设置，因为组织实际部署的正是这种受门控的调用路径。

Claude Fable 5 ships with dual-use safety classifiers, and Anthropic’s default serves flagged requests with Claude Opus 4.8 instead; we keep this default, since the gated route is what an organization deploys.

试验流程Trial protocol.

一次试验会让该组合以无头方式运行，直到运行框架返回或任务超时；无论哪种情况，官方验证器都会对最终环境评分，因此即使运行超时仍可能通过，其 PASS 或 FAIL 就是试验分数。运行框架内部的重试属于试验的一部分。配置、预检、提供方、运行框架或验证器故障会使一次尝试无效；我们会记录、排除并重新运行，直到该单元包含三次有效试验。已经评分的试验绝不会重跑。

A trial runs the bundle headlessly until the harness returns or the task’s timeout is reached; either way the official verifier scores the resulting environment, so a timed-out execution can still pass, and its PASS or FAIL is the trial score. Harness-internal retries are part of the trial. Provisioning, pre-flight, provider, harness, or verifier malfunctions invalidate an attempt, which we log, exclude, and rerun until the cell holds three valid trials; a scored trial is never rerun.

任务级成本采样Task-level cost sampling.

为刻画单次运行的成本分布，我们选取两项任务，在 Control 和 NIST-derived high 条件下，各进行 100 次运行，使用 GPT-5.6 Luna—Codex 组合：compile-compcert 的成功率几乎不受加固影响，而 caffe-cifar-10 的成功率则大幅下降。我们阅读了全部 200 条加固条件下的轨迹，以便将观察到的成本变化归因于具体机制。

To characterize per-run cost distributions, we picked two tasks and evaluated them with the GPT-5.6 Luna–Codex bundle at 100 runs per condition under control and NIST-derived high: compile-compcert, whose success rate hardening leaves nearly unchanged, and caffe-cifar-10, whose success rate degrades sharply. We read all 200 hardened-condition trajectories to attribute the observed cost movement to a mechanism.

模型—运行框架消融研究Model-harness ablation study.

为检验帕累托前沿两端的成本极值来自模型还是运行框架，我们分别用 Codex 和 Grok Build 评估低成本端代表 GPT-5.6 Luna，以及高成本端代表 Grok 4.5。该实验将运行框架对受限环境下模型表现的影响区分出来。

To test whether the two cost extremes of the Pareto frontier follow the model or its harness, we evaluate GPT-5.6 Luna, which anchors the low-cost side, and Grok 4.5, which anchors the high-cost side, with both Codex and Grok Build. This experiment disentangles the effect of the harness from the model’s performance in the restricted environment.

基础设施Infrastructure.

每次试验都在隔离的云沙箱（Daytona）中运行，该沙箱由任务自己的 Terminal-Bench 镜像构建；CPU 和内存遵循 Terminal-Bench 对该任务的规格，我们不作更改。模型推理通过单一 OpenRouter 路由提供服务，并为各运行框架配置相应的厂商端点。软件版本见附录 E。

Each trial runs in an isolated cloud sandbox (Daytona) built from the task’s own Terminal-Bench image; the sandbox’s CPU and memory follow that task’s Terminal-Bench specification, which we do not override. Model inference is served over a single OpenRouter route with per-harness vendor endpoints. Software versions are all in Appendix E.

鲁棒性度量Robustness Measure

为衡量组合在限制下的鲁棒性，我们用两个数概括每个组合—策略单元，按组合在整个任务池上计算：成功率 SRₘ(ℓ)，即模型组合 m 在条件 ℓ 下所有任务和重复试验中的通过试验比例；以及每项任务的平均成本 Cₘ(ℓ)，单位为美元。组合在受限条件下的变化量，是相对于其自身 Control 数值的变化。

To measure a bundle’s robustness under restriction, we summarize each bundle–policy cell by two numbers, computed per bundle over the task pool: the success rate SRm​(ℓ)\mathrm{SR}_{m}(\ell), the percentage of passing trials over all tasks and repetitions of bundle mm under condition ℓ\ell, and the mean cost per task Cm​(ℓ)C_{m}(\ell), in US dollars. A bundle’s shift under a restricted condition is the change from its own control values.

Δ​SRm​(ℓ)=SRm​(ℓ)−SRm​(control),Δ​Cm​(ℓ)=100⋅Cm​(ℓ)−Cm​(control)Cm​(control),\begin{array}[]{rcl}\Delta\mathrm{SR}_{m}(\ell)&=&\mathrm{SR}_{m}(\ell)-\mathrm{SR}_{m}(\mathrm{control}),\\ \Delta C_{m}(\ell)&=&\displaystyle 100\cdot\frac{C_{m}(\ell)-C_{m}(\mathrm{control})}{C_{m}(\mathrm{control})},\end{array}
(1)

对于受限条件 ℓ∈{non-root, NIST-derived high}，ΔSRₘ(ℓ) 是以百分点表示的绝对差值；ΔCₘ(ℓ) 则以该组合自身的 Control 成本为分母，因此即使各组合绝对成本相差数个数量级，也可以比较。在任务层面，我们使用成本倍数：将某组合—任务在一种策略下已完成运行（PASS 或 FAIL）的平均成本除以其 Control 平均成本，再对各组合—任务对等权平均。

For the restricted conditions ℓ∈{non-root,NIST-derived high}\ell\in\{\text{non-root},\allowbreak\text{NIST-derived high}\}, Δ​SRm​(ℓ)\Delta\mathrm{SR}_{m}(\ell) is an absolute difference in percentage points; Δ​Cm​(ℓ)\Delta C_{m}(\ell) is normalized by the bundle’s own control cost, making it comparable across bundles whose absolute costs differ by orders of magnitude. At task level we use the cost multiplier: a bundle–task pair’s mean cost over completed (PASS or FAIL) runs under a policy divided by its mean control cost, averaged with equal weight across pairs.

结果Results

策略下的成功率—成本前沿The Success–Cost Frontier under Policy

图 1 将每个组合置于三种策略下的成功率—成本平面。每种策略下都出现清晰的帕累托前沿，而不只是在 Control 下：Control 条件下，Codex 组合从成本最低的 GPT-5.6 Luna 到得分最高的 GPT-5.6 Sol 构成前沿；在两种加固策略下，Grok 4.5 加入了前沿的高成本端；

Figure 1 places each bundle in the success–cost plane under the three policies. A clear Pareto frontier emerges under every policy, not only under control: the Codex bundles trace it under control, from the cheapest (GPT-5.6 Luna) up to the highest-scoring (GPT-5.6 Sol), and under both

在具有可解性见证的 82 项任务上，Grok 4.5 在 NIST-derived high 下与 GPT-5.6 Sol 并列，但由于成本更高而退出前沿（附录 F）。收紧策略会使前沿向下并向右移动，即以成功率换取成本。各组合受到的影响差异很大：有些模型在策略下损失的任务成功率明显多于其他模型；有些则更多以成本上升而非成功率下降来承担策略影响。后续分析将讨论各模型之间的这种差异及其成因。

hardened policies Grok 4.5 joins its high-cost end; on the 82 tasks with a solvability witness Grok 4.5 instead ties with GPT-5.6 Sol under NIST-derived high and leaves the frontier as the costlier of the two (Appendix F). Tightening the policy pushes this frontier lower and further right, trading success for cost. That movement is far from uniform across bundles: some models forfeit noticeably more task success under policy than others, and some absorb the policy more as inflated cost than as lost success. We take up this per-model heterogeneity, and what drives it, in the analyses that follow.

模型—运行框架消融Model–harness ablation.

无论使用哪种运行框架、处于哪种策略下，Grok 4.5 的成本始终更高（表 1）；而将任一端点模型换到另一种运行框架后，各策略下的成功率都会下降。Luna—Grok Build 组合向下、向左移动，是因为支出降低的同时成功率损失大得多，并不代表它提供了更有用的工作点。

Grok 4.5 remains the higher-cost model under both harnesses and all three policies (Table 1), whereas moving either endpoint model to the other harness lowers success at every policy. The Luna–Grok Build bundle moves down and left because its lower spend accompanies a much larger success loss, not because it offers a more useful operating point.

对限制的敏感性Restriction Sensitivity

图 2 绘出了公式（1）所定义的变化量，并以图 1 中各组合自身的 Control 工作点作归一化。每项任务均计入三次有效试验，并由原始验证器评分，因此这些数值产生于验证器修复之前；下一小节所述的基准问题则是在这些结果之上进一步处理的。

Figure 2 plots the shifts of Eq. (1), normalized by each bundle’s control operating point in Figure 1. Each task contributes its three valid trials, scored by the original verifiers, so these numbers predate the verifier repairs and the artifact separation of the next subsection applies on top of them.

在 NIST-derived high 下，每个组合的点估计在两个维度上都变差：加固使全部十二个组合的成功率下降、每项任务的平均成本上升，因此图 2 中所有点都落在同一象限内。但在该象限中，两个维度并不同步，各组合付出的代价形式也不同。Grok 4.5 的成功率损失最小（−7.1 个百分点），但成本膨胀幅度远高于其他模型（+167.3%）；Claude Sonnet 5 的成功率损失最大（−18.3 个百分点），成本膨胀则相对温和（+21.4%）；GPT-5.6 Luna 与 Grok 4.5 相反，成本膨胀最小（+16.0%），而成功率损失几乎同样大

Under NIST-derived high, every bundle’s point estimate worsens on both axes: hardening lowers the success rate and raises the mean cost per task for all twelve bundles, so every point in Figure 2 falls in the same quadrant. Within that quadrant the two axes do not move together, and bundles pay in different currencies. Grok 4.5 gives up the least success (−7.1-7.1 pp) but absorbs the largest cost inflation by a wide margin (+167.3%+167.3\%); Claude Sonnet 5 loses the most success (−18.3-18.3 pp) at a comparatively modest cost inflation (+21.4%+21.4\%); GPT-5.6 Luna is the mirror of Grok 4.5, showing the smallest cost inflation (+16.0%+16.0\%) with a success loss nearly as large

（−18.0 个百分点）。每个单元只有三次试验，且未给出区间，因此我们将这些数值视为组合间的分布，而不是排名。

(−18.0-18.0 pp). With three trials per cell and no intervals we report

五项经验证器修复的任务都包含在这个任务池中；修复后，其中两项在 NIST-derived high 下的成功率有所提高。因此，这里报告的损失略有高估（见下一小节）。

this as a spread across bundles, not as a ranking. All five verifier-repaired tasks lie inside this pool, and their repairs raise success under NIST-derived high on two of them, so the losses reported here are slightly overstated (next subsection).

策略下的基准问题Benchmark Artifacts under Policy

由于足够严格的策略可能使任务无法求解，而不仅是更难，我们首先逐一确认每项 Terminal-Bench 任务在 NIST-derived high 强制执行下是否仍然可解。大多数任务仍可解：89 项中有 82 项具有可解性见证，即在该策略下达到官方通过状态的轨迹。其中 50 项使用 Terminal-Bench 自带且未修改的参考解作为见证；其余 32 项则由我们编写符合策略的参考解，且不更改任务本身（附录 B）。我们将前一组称为「未受影响」任务（50 项），后一组称为「受影响」任务（32 项）。

Because a sufficiently strict policy can render a task not merely harder but unsolvable, we begin by establishing, for every Terminal-Bench task, whether it remains solvable under NIST-derived high enforcement. Most tasks remain solvable: 82 of the 89 have a solvability witness, a trajectory that reaches the official passing state under the policy. For 50 the witness is Terminal-Bench’s own reference solution, unchanged; for the other 32 we author a policy-compliant reference solution ourselves, changing no task (Appendix B). We call these the unaffected (50) and affected (32) subsets.

有七项任务在设计上受阻：不存在符合策略的解。这一发现本身也强化了本文的核心论点，因为这些任务的要求与加固环境不相容。我们仍在所报告结果中保留全部 89 项任务，并分层分析各个子集。

Seven tasks are blocked by design: no policy-compliant solution exists. This is itself a finding that reinforces our central claim, their requirements are incompatible with a hardened environment, and we keep all 89 tasks in the reported results, analyzing the slices separately.

凡验证器报告失败、但智能体已经达到明示目标的情况，根本原因都是验证器过度规格化：它要求某个被策略阻止、但任务本身并未要求的附带细节。例如，工具只需可用，验证器却要求安装在某个指定路径。这种失效模式已在代码生成基准中记录（Sharifloo et al., 2025）。对于这五个验证器，我们仅以添加方式扩展断言，使其也接受智能体可写的工作区，同时保留所有实质性检查；修复后的同一验证器在每个策略级别（包括 Control）运行，原始结果也保留以供审计。

Wherever a verifier indicated failure although the agent had achieved the stated goal, the root cause was an over-specified verifier: an assertion demanding an incidental detail that the policy blocks but the task never required, for example one exact installation path for a tool that only needs to be available, a failure mode documented in code-generation benchmarks (Sharifloo et al. 2025). For each of the five such verifiers we additively broaden the assertion to also accept the agent’s writable workspace, leaving every substantive check intact; the identical verifier runs at every policy level, including control, with original outcomes kept for audit.

主要结果（图 1）包含这两类基准问题。在 NIST-derived high 下重新评分后，五项修复任务中的两项成功率有所提高（表 2）；两项恢复情况相同：智能体已在可写工作区中构建所需工具，而原始检查从未查看该位置。

The headline results (Figure 1) include both artifact classes. Rescoring under NIST-derived high increases the success rate on two of the five repaired tasks (Table 2), both recoveries with the same shape: the agent had built the required tool in its writable workspace, where the original check never looked.

另外三项在两种验证器下的结果均未改变，这说明修复纠正的是检查方式，而非抬高分数：一项即使在 Control 下也未被解决，另外两项则因真实的加固原因而失败。对于 mcmc-sampling-stan，每个组合都安装了采样器并计算出正确的后验均值，但没有一个能让第二个进程看到该安装，因此所有试验中，启动全新会话的检查都会失败（附录 B）。

The other three are unchanged under either verifier, confirming the repairs correct the checks rather than inflate scores: one is unsolved even in control, and two fail for genuine hardening reasons; on mcmc-sampling-stan every bundle installed the sampler and computed correct posterior means, yet none made the installation visible to a second process, so checks that open a fresh session fail in every trial (Appendix B).

加固下，七项在设计上受阻的任务对所有组合都会确定失败：只看有见证的 82 项任务，会使各组合在加固条件下的成功率提高 3.4 至 5.8 个百分点，而 Control 下基本不变；这从每项测得惩罚中都扣除了大致相同的 5 至 7 个百分点。剩余差异仍有区分度：在缩减后的任务池中，从 Control 到加固条件的降幅介于 Grok 4.5 的 2.4 个百分点和 Claude Sonnet 5 的 13.5 个百分点之间；完整任务池中的范围则为 7.1 至 18.3 个百分点。附录 F 完整报告了这两个任务池中每个组合在各策略下的成功率和成本。

Under hardening the seven blocked-by-design tasks are guaranteed failures for every bundle alike: restricting to the 82 witnessed tasks raises each bundle’s hardened success by 3.4 to 5.8 points while leaving control essentially unchanged, removing a roughly common five to seven points from every measured penalty. What remains discriminates: the control-to-hardened drop runs from 2.4 points (Grok 4.5) to 13.5 (Claude Sonnet 5) on the reduced pool, against 7.1 to 18.3 on the full pool; Appendix F reports both pools in full, every bundle’s success rate and cost under each policy.

提供方侧安全干预Provider-side safety interventions.

Anthropic 和 OpenAI 在服务层运行安全分类器，可能在验证器评分前终止试验；这些分类器响应请求内容，任何调用同一路由的组织都会遇到它们。在整个评测过程中，这影响了十二个组合中的五个，共 98 次试验。按照衡量已部署组合的方式，我们在报告的汇总结果中保留所有受影响试验。只有 OpenAI 路由会重试中断的流；Anthropic 的拒绝都会结束试验。Claude Fable 5 的既定 Opus 4.8 回退机制（实验设置）为其 29.9% 的请求提供服务，因此其结果反映的是受门控的调用路径，而非 Claude Fable 5 单独的表现。对任何组合而言，干预导致的失败最多使测得成功率下降 2.2 个百分点，且干预发生率不会随策略严重程度增加；附录 D 记录了各项机制、消息和次数。

Anthropic and OpenAI operate safety classifiers inside their serving layers that can end a trial before the verifier runs; they respond to request content, and any organization calling the same route encounters them. Across the campaign they affected five of the twelve bundles and 98 trials. We retain every affected trial in the reported aggregates, consistent with measuring the bundle as deployed. Only the OpenAI route retries a dropped stream; every Anthropic refusal ends its trial. Claude Fable 5’s declared Opus 4.8 fallback (Experimental Setup) served 29.9% of its requests, so its results describe the gated route rather than Fable 5 alone. Intervention-caused failures cost any bundle at most 2.2 percentage points of measured success, and incidence does not rise with policy severity; Appendix D documents each mechanism, message, and count.

性能下降机制Mechanisms of Degradation

在 82 项具有可解性见证的任务上，加固仍使成功率下降 7.4 个百分点（从 72.5% 降至 65.1%，表 3）。按失败运行相对于任务墙钟预算的终止位置分类后可以看出，新增失败有两类：耗尽预算的运行（超时比例从 12.0% 升至 16.4%），以及在预算尚未耗尽时结束、但解未通过验证的运行（错误解比例从 12.8% 升至 15.5%）。策略下智能体并没有更常放弃：提前停止比例仅从 2.4% 微升至 2.7%。加固新增的失败中，约 59% 是超时，37% 是错误解。

On the 82 tasks that admit a solvability witness, hardening still costs 7.4 points of success (72.5% to 65.1%, Table 3). Classifying each failed run by where it terminates relative to its task’s wall-clock budget shows the additional failures are of two kinds: runs that exhaust the budget (timeouts, 12.0% to 16.4% of runs) and runs that end well within it with a solution that fails verification (wrong solutions, 12.8% to 15.5%). Agents do not give up more often under policy: early stops barely move (2.4% to 2.7%). Of the failures hardening adds, roughly 59% are timeouts and 37% wrong solutions.

同样的压力也体现在成功的运行中：在同一组合和任务内匹配通过的运行后，加固条件下的通过运行比 Control 对照多耗费 13% 墙钟时间、14% 工具调用和 26% token。在 NIST-derived high 下，超时类别增长得足够快，超过错误解，成为最常见的失败。失败组合因模型而异：在 Terminus-2 上评估的开放权重模型造成了大多数新增超时；Codex 组合新增的则几乎全是在预算内结束的错误解。

The same pressure is visible in the runs that succeed: matching passing runs within the same bundle and task, a hardened pass takes 13% more wall-clock time, 14% more tool calls, and 26% more tokens than its control counterpart. Under NIST-derived high the timeout class grows fast enough to overtake wrong solutions as the most common failure. The mix is bundle-dependent: the open-weight bundles evaluated on Terminus-2 account for most of the additional timeouts, while the Codex bundles add almost exclusively wrong solutions within budget.

策略导致的成本膨胀Cost Inflation under Policy

成本是加固影响的第二种代价形式。图 3 展示 NIST-derived high 如何改变两项深度采样任务的成本分布。两项任务的中位成本增幅相近，说明策略带来的成本与其对成功率的影响相互独立。通过和失败的运行同样承担成本增加。新增成本几乎完全来自构造变通方案（97%）：智能体放弃被阻断的路径，转而从源代码重建工具链或寻找替代数据；这种重建带来额外开销。成本极低的少数情况则是运行在受阻后很快提前结束。

Hardening’s second currency is cost. Figure 3 shows how the NIST-derived high policy shifts the cost distributions of the two deep-sampled tasks. The median cost increase is comparable in both cases, decoupling the cost of policy from its effect on success. Passing and failing runs pay the shift alike. The mechanism is almost exclusively workaround construction (97%): the agent abandons the blocked path and rebuilds a tool-chain from source or sources substitute data, and this reconstruction produces the added cost; the few low-cost extremes are runs that stop early once blocked.

图 4 按

Figure 4 stratifies the cost effect by

参考解兼容性分层。将七项在设计上受阻的任务加入受影响子集后，共有 39 项任务，结果为

reference-solution compatibility. Adding the seven blocked-by-design tasks to the affected subset gives 39 tasks and yields

在 non-root 下为 3.03 倍 [1.81, 5.56]，在 NIST-derived high 下为 3.48 倍 [2.37, 5.56]。「受影响」描述的是参考解证据，并不代表每条智能体轨迹：在参考解未受影响的任务上，智能体也可能走上受策略影响的轨迹，这与该子集中残留的轻微成本膨胀相符；较少数情况下，智能体也可能在标记为受影响的任务上走出一条未受影响的轨迹。这些区间量化的是各子集内部的不确定性，并非检验子集之间的差异。

3.03×3.03\times [1.81, 5.56] under non-root and 3.48×3.48\times [2.37, 5.56]. “Affected” describes reference-solution evidence rather than every agent trajectory: an agent may follow a policy-affected trajectory on a task with an unaffected reference solution, consistent with the small residual inflation in the unaffected subset, or, less often, an unaffected trajectory on an affected-label task. The intervals quantify within-subset uncertainty rather than testing between-subset differences.

同样的分层也能预测成功率损失。在受影响子集中，成功率在 NIST-derived high 下从 70.3% 降至 54.5%（下降 15.8 个百分点）；在未受影响子集中，成功率从 73.8% 变为 71.8%，差异无法与噪声区分。表 3 中新增失败的 83.5% 落在 32 项受影响任务上，轨迹延长也集中于这些任务（匹配的通过运行多耗费 36% 墙钟时间和 70% token；未受影响任务没有可测量的变化）。两个子集在 Control 下的成功率几乎相同，因此差异并非组间任务难度造成：只有在强制执行策略后才出现分化。由此，任务的参考解兼容性可以在任何智能体运行前计算，并预示策略会在哪些任务上造成成本和成功率损失。

The same stratification predicts the success penalty. On the affected subset the success rate falls from 70.3% to 54.5% under NIST-derived high (15.8 points), while on the unaffected subset it moves from 73.8% to 71.8%, a change indistinguishable from noise; 83.5% of the additional failures in Table 3 fall on the 32 affected tasks, and the trajectory lengthening concentrates there as well (36% more wall-clock time and 70% more tokens for matched passing runs, against no measurable change on unaffected tasks). The two subsets have nearly identical control success rates, so the divergence is not a difficulty difference between the groups: it appears only once the policy is enforced. A task’s reference-solution compatibility, computable before any agent runs, therefore anticipates where a policy will cost both money and success.

策略下的阻断动作Blocked Actions under Policy

最后，我们衡量智能体实际遇到的限制。一次「阻断动作」是指一个被拒绝的操作，只统计证据已验证完整的试验（附录 G）。按设计，Control 不会产生阻断动作；在 non-root 下，每个阻断动作都是权限拒绝。在 NIST-derived high 下，约三分之一试验（2,051 次中的 675 次）至少记录了一次阻断。网络出站拒绝在各项指标上都最多（500 次试验，权限拒绝为 283 次，文件系统拒绝为 158 次）；它们占总量 90.5%，主要是由于重复尝试：遇到网络出口限制的试验平均记录 10.5 次拒绝，而权限拒绝平均为 1.4 次。在具有已验证证据的 88 项任务中，阻断高度集中（其余一项任务的轨迹始终被截断）：14 项记录到已验证的零次阻断，48 项总计不超过五次，而五项任务占了总量的一半（build-pov-ray、break-filter-js-from-html、mteb-retrieve、protein-assembly、count-dataset-tokens）。

Finally, we measure the restrictions agents actually hit. A blocked action is one denied operation, counted from verified-complete evidence only (Appendix G). By design, control has no blocked actions; under non-root every blocked action is a privilege denial. Under NIST-derived high, a third of trials (675 of 2,051) record at least one. Egress denials lead on every measure (500 trials, against 283 privilege and 158 filesystem), and their 90.5% share of volume is mostly persistence: a trial that hits the egress wall records 10.5 denials on average, against 1.4 for privilege. Blocks concentrate sharply across the 88 tasks with verified evidence (the remaining task’s traces are always truncated): 14 record a verified zero, 48 record five or fewer in total, and five carry half the volume (build-pov-ray, break-filter-js-from-html, mteb-retrieve, protein-assembly, count-dataset-tokens).

阻断暴露程度随可解性而变化：至少遭遇一次阻断的试验，在未受影响子集中占 14.4%，在受影响子集中占 51.6%，在设计上受阻的任务中占 67.8%；而在受影响任务中，失败试验记录的阻断动作数是通过试验的 2.7 倍。这些是诊断性关联，并非因果关系（附录 G）。

Exposure follows solvability: trials with at least one blocked action rise from 14.4% on the unaffected subset, to 51.6% on the affected subset, to 67.8% on tasks blocked by design, and on affected tasks failing trials record 2.7 times the blocked actions of passing ones. These are diagnostic associations, not causes (Appendix G).

局限性Limitations

单一基准。全部证据都来自 Terminal-Bench 及其 89 项任务。Boundary-Bench 作用于运行时，而非任务内容；但每增加一个基准，都要重新进行可解性审计、编写见证解，并承担完整十二组合评测网格的推理开销。因此，本文结论目前仅在这个基准上得到确立。

Single benchmark. All evidence comes from Terminal-Bench and its 89 tasks. Boundary-Bench attaches to the runtime rather than to task content, but every added benchmark would repeat the solvability audit, the witness authoring, and the inference spend of the full twelve-bundle grid; our findings are therefore established for this benchmark only.

组合层面的归因。评估单位是冻结的模型—运行框架组合，因此无法将影响归因于模型权重或运行框架本身。表 1 的消融仅覆盖帕累托前沿成本两端；改变运行框架也会改变提示、工具和界面。因此，对完整模型名单的归因仍停留在组合层面。

Bundle-level attribution. The evaluated unit is the frozen model–harness bundle, so effects are not attributed to model weights or the harness alone. The ablation of Table 1 covers only the frontier’s two cost extremes, and a harness change alters the prompt, tools, and interface; full-roster attribution remains bundle-level.

单一工作点，三次试验。所有主要评估组合都使用 high 推理强度；每个组合—任务—策略单元进行三次有效试验。没有评估其他推理强度或试验次数。区间描述的是这一配置下运行间的变异性；帕累托、敏感性和次序陈述均为描述性结果，不应过度解读组合间的小幅差异。

One operating point, three trials. Every primary bundle runs at high reasoning effort with three valid trials per bundle–task–policy cell; no other effort setting or trial count is evaluated. Intervals describe run-to-run variability at this configuration; Pareto, sensitivity, and ordering statements are descriptive, and small differences between bundles should not be over-read.

策略真实性。三个条件构成一条源自常见企业限制设置、并映射到 NIST SP 800-53 控制族的严重程度阶梯。它们不是经过认证的部署配置；我们衡量的是这些限制的性能代价，而非其安全有效性。

Policy realism. The three conditions form one severity ladder derived from common enterprise restriction settings and mapped to NIST SP 800-53 families. They are not a certified deployment configuration, and we measure their performance cost, not their effectiveness as security.

结论Conclusion

安全限制是编码智能体真实运行环境的一部分，但基准评估通常不包含这些限制。我们在 Terminal-Bench 2.1 上、以三种由原生机制强制执行的策略级别评估十二种模型—运行框架组合，并得出四点结论。

Security restrictions are part of the coding agent’s real operating environment, yet benchmarks measure agents without them. Evaluating twelve model–harness bundles on Terminal-Bench 2.1 under three natively enforced policy levels, we draw four conclusions.

加固的影响并不一致。在最严格的 NIST-derived high 策略下，每个组合的成功率都会下降、成本都会上升，但幅度各不相同：成功率损失最高达 18.3 个百分点，成本膨胀最高达 167.3%。

Hardening is non-uniform. Every bundle loses success and gains cost under the strictest policy, NIST-derived high, but by amounts that differ across bundles: success losses reach 18.3 points and cost inflation 167.3%.

权衡普遍存在，但代价形式各不相同。有些组合以成本膨胀承担策略影响，有些以成功率下降承担，没有组合能同时避开两者。损失表现为持续消耗，而非放弃：轨迹变长并以超时或错误解告终，几乎不会提前停止。因此应依据部署环境的策略配置预算。

The trade-off is universal; its currency is not. Some bundles absorb the policy as inflated cost, others as lost success, and none escapes both. The loss is grinding rather than surrender: longer trajectories ending in timeouts or wrong solutions, almost never in early stops, so budgets must be provisioned under the deployment’s policy.

代价可以预测。给定一项策略，参考解兼容性可以在任何智能体运行前识别受影响任务，并同时预测成功率和成本变化；该流程适用于任何提供参考解的基准。

The tax is predictable. Given a policy, reference-solution compatibility identifies the affected tasks before any agent runs, for success and cost alike, and the procedure applies to any benchmark that ships reference solutions.

基准应包含策略维度。加固会降低包括前沿模型在内的表现，从而恢复区分模型的空间；只有依据实际部署环境的策略才能有效选择模型。应当逐步将共同受限环境中的性能报告变成标准做法。

Benchmarks should carry a policy axis. Hardening degrades even frontier bundles, restoring discriminative headroom, and model selection is only valid under the deployment’s own policy; reporting performance in a common restricted environment should become standard practice.

自然的后续工作包括将可解性审计扩展到更多基准，并构建能够减轻本文所量化机制影响、会适应策略的智能体。

Natural next steps are extending the solvability audit to further benchmarks and building policy-adaptive agents that mitigate the mechanisms quantified here.
