附录 A：策略构造细节Appendix A: Policy Construction Details

本附录完整说明 Boundary-Bench 章节所概述的 NIST-derived high 策略构造方式：三个加固维度（网络、文件系统和权限）、每项限制所增加的原生强制机制与 NIST 控制，以及用于验证这些限制的预检探针。

This appendix gives the full construction of the NIST-derived high policy summarized in the Boundary-Bench section of the main paper: its three hardening axes (network, filesystem, and privilege), the native enforcement and NIST controls each adds, and the pre-flight probes that verify them.

维度定义Axis Definitions

每个维度均由独立的原生机制强制执行，并映射到其在运行时所体现的 NIST 控制。该映射记录了启发各项机制的控制，并不构成合规性声明。表 4 概述了 NIST-derived high 状态下的三个维度；后续段落列出只读目录树和权限锁定细节，表 5 则给出完整的出站白名单。

Each axis is enforced by a distinct native mechanism, mapped to the NIST controls it projects onto the runtime. The mapping records the controls that motivated each mechanism and is not a compliance claim. Table 4 summarizes the three axes at the NIST-derived high posture; the paragraphs that follow give the read-only trees and privilege lockdown, and Table 5 reproduces the exact egress allowlist.

网络实现Network implementation.

在 NIST-derived high 下，所有出站流量都被强制通过环回代理；代理会默认拒绝白名单以外的所有域名。该固定白名单包含 205 个开发域名，改编自 Claude Code on the web 的默认白名单，²其中包括模型服务端点和当前运行框架自身的厂商端点；完整列表见表 5。我们没有添加任何任务专用域名：我们从官方参考解中提取每项任务的网络依赖（89 项任务中有 36 项至少需要一个域名，涉及 30 个不同域名，其中 9 个已在白名单内），并刻意不放行其余 21 个，因此该白名单并非针对受评任务定制。仅网络出口受阻就使一项任务无法完成（count-dataset-tokens；附录 B）。对其他所有白名单外依赖，都可以通过白名单内的主机获取等效资源，因此求解者可以绕过阻断；例如 CRAN 受阻时，可从白名单内的 conda-forge 通道安装相同 R 软件包；也可以从白名单内的 Ubuntu 镜像而非 Debian 镜像获取工具链。代理由 root 所有，而防火墙规则仅作用于智能体用户，因此智能体无法绕过或关闭代理。同一规则也会拒绝云元数据端点和私有地址范围，并重新检查解析出的地址，以防允许的域名解析到被拒绝的地址范围。被阻止的域名会返回不带正文的 HTTP 403；绕过代理的直接出站连接则会因连接被拒而失败。

Under NIST-derived high, all egress is forced through a loopback proxy that default-denies every domain outside its allowlist: a fixed 205-domain developer list adapted from the default allowlist for Claude Code on the web,2Claude Code on the web 默认允许的域名清单，详见官方文档。2 2 https://code.claude.com/docs/en/claude-code-on-the-web“#default-allowed-domains which includes the model-serving endpoints, plus the running harness’s own vendor endpoint; the full list is reproduced in Table 5. No task-specific domains are added: we extracted each task’s network dependencies from its official reference solution (36 of the 89 tasks require at least one, spanning 30 distinct domains, of which 9 already fall inside the allowlist), and deliberately did not admit the remaining 21, so the allowlist is not fitted to the evaluated tasks. Exactly one task is thereby foreclosed by an egress blockage alone (count-dataset-tokens; Appendix B): for every other out-of-list dependency, an equivalent artifact is reachable through an allowlisted host, so a solver can route around the blockage, for example, installing the same R packages from the allowlisted conda-forge channel when CRAN is blocked, or obtaining a toolchain from the allowlisted Ubuntu mirrors rather than Debian’s. The proxy runs with root ownership while the firewall rule is scoped to the agent’s user, so the proxy cannot be bypassed or disabled from inside the policy; the same rules deny the cloud-metadata endpoint and private address ranges, and resolved addresses are rechecked so an allowed domain cannot resolve into a denied range. A blocked domain returns a bare HTTP 403; direct egress that skips the proxy fails with a refused connection.

文件系统实现Filesystem implementation.

受保护的操作系统目录包括 /usr、/bin、/sbin、/lib、/lib64、/etc、/opt、/boot、/srv、/root、/var 和 /home；每个目录都以绑定挂载方式重新挂载为只读。工作目录（/app、/workspace）、临时与共享内存路径（/tmp、/dev/shm），以及智能体运行框架自身的运行时和缓存目录（~/.cache、~/.config、~/.local，以及 ~/.claude 或 ~/.codex 等运行框架目录）仍可写；主目录中的其余部分和 /var/tmp 均为只读。在可写范围之外写入会返回 EROFS。所有位置仍可读取；这一机制限制的是篡改，而非机密性。

The protected operating-system trees are /usr, /bin, /sbin, /lib, /lib64, /etc, /opt, /boot, /srv, /root, /var, and /home; each is bind-remounted read-only. The working directories (/app, /workspace), the scratch paths (/tmp, /dev/shm), and the agent’s runtime and cache directories (~/.cache, ~/.config, ~/.local, and the running harness’s own directory such as ~/.claude or ~/.codex) remain writable; the rest of the home directory and /var/tmp are read-only. Writes outside the writable set fail with EROFS. Reads remain available everywhere; the mechanism restricts tampering rather than confidentiality.

权限实现Privilege implementation.

在 non-root 和 NIST-derived high 两种受限策略下，setpriv 都会将智能体降权为专用用户和用户组；该用户不在 sudoers 列表中，root 密码也已锁定，因此无法通过 sudo 或 su 提权。两种策略还会安装一条针对智能体用户的防火墙规则；这条规则属于网络策略维度之外的保护，用于拒绝访问沙箱提供方自身的控制平面端口，以封闭一条平台提权路径。NIST-derived high 进一步设置 no_new_privs，使执行的程序无法获取更高权限；清空 Linux 能力边界集，并从任务镜像中移除 setuid 位。挂载文件系统、修改防火墙规则和打开原始套接字等操作都会因 EPERM 而失败。

Under both non-root and NIST-derived high restricted policies, setpriv drops the agent to a dedicated user and group; the user has no sudoers entry, and the root password is locked, so sudo and su escalation fail. Both policies also install a firewall rule, scoped to the agent’s user and outside the network policy axis, that rejects access to the sandbox provider’s own control-plane ports, closing a platform escalation path. NIST-derived high additionally sets no_new_privs so no executed program can gain privilege, empties the Linux capability bounding set, and strips setuid bits from the task image. Mounting filesystems, changing firewall rules, and opening raw sockets then fail with EPERM.

质量控制Quality Control

每个沙箱启动一次预检探针组，在智能体开始运行前、且不计入任务执行时间，检查所有已配置的阻断：直接探针确认目标操作确实被拒绝；对抗性探针尝试绕过限制（嵌套 shell、原始 IP 和替代端口出站、子进程继承）；启用探针则确认获准的操作仍然成功。由于这些探针在智能体启动前运行，其失败绝不会被归类为智能体失败，也不会计入任务评分。相反，该次尝试会被视为基础设施错误而丢弃，并由新的沙箱替代。任何无法建立的加固步骤也会失败关闭，而不会在未加固状态下继续运行。探针不会留下痕迹；智能体开始运行前，会验证其临时区域已被清除。

Enforcement is checked by a pre-flight probe suite, run once per sandbox before the agent starts and outside task-execution time, that exercises every configured blockage: direct probes confirm each restriction denies its target operation, adversarial probes attempt bypasses (nested shells, raw-IP and alternate-port egress, child-process inheritance), and enablement probes confirm permitted operations still succeed. Because these probes run before the agent starts, a required probe failure can never be classified as an agent failure or scored against the task. Instead, the attempt is discarded as an infrastructure error and replaced by a fresh sandbox. A hardening step that cannot be established likewise fails closed rather than running unhardened. The probes leave no trace; their scratch area is verifiably removed before the agent begins.

附录 B：NIST-derived high 下的可解性见证Appendix B: Solvability Witnesses under NIST-derived high

在将模型失败归因于模型本身前，我们要求任务具备可解性见证：至少一条在策略下达到官方通过状态的解题轨迹。每项任务的官方参考解是自然的首选候选，即兼容性探针。因此，我们在 NIST-derived high 下重放每项任务随附的参考解。该策略固定使用可信的 205 域名开发者出站白名单、不允许按任务添加域名、将操作系统和主目录树设为只读，并以非 root 身份运行且移除能力；只有某条轨迹达到官方通过状态时，我们才将任务视为兼容。

Before attributing a model’s failure to the model, we require a solvability witness for the task: at least one solution trajectory that reaches the official passing state under the policy. Each task’s official reference solution is the natural first candidate—a compatibility probe. We therefore replayed every task’s shipped reference solution under NIST-derived high (a fixed trusted 205-domain developer egress allowlist with no per-task domains, read-only operating-system and home trees, and non-root execution with capabilities dropped), and treated a task as compatible only when some trajectory reached the official passing state.

使参考解适应策略Adapting reference solutions to the policy.

许多随附的参考解都假设运行在不受限制的 Control 环境中：它们用 apt-get install 全局安装软件包、通过 sudo 提权，或从白名单以外的主机下载文件。在 NIST-derived high 下，这些步骤会因 EROFS、EPERM 或出站访问阻断而失败。对于这类任务，我们编写可解性见证，只使用策略允许的操作达到同一通过状态：以 rootless 方式将软件安装到可写工作区（使用完全固定版本的 @EXPLICIT conda-forge 安装方案，或采用下载并解压 apt sysroot 的模式），且所有下载都限制在可信白名单内。见证解既不改变任务环境，也不修改验证器；它只是一个符合策略的轨迹，这正是兼容性探针所需确认的内容。

Many shipped solutions assume the unrestricted control environment: they install packages system-wide with apt-get install, escalate with sudo, or fetch from hosts outside the allowlist. Under NIST-derived high these steps fail with EROFS, EPERM, or a blocked-egress error. For such tasks we authored solvability witnesses that reach the same passing state using only operations the policy permits: rootless installation into the writable workspace (a fully pinned (@EXPLICIT) conda-forge transaction, or a download-and-extract apt sysroot pattern), with all fetches restricted to the trusted allowlist. A witness changes neither the task environment nor its verifier—it is one admissible trajectory, which is exactly what the compatibility probe requires.

诊断剩余不可解任务Diagnosing residual infeasibility.

仍有一组任务无法获得见证解。逐项检查后，我们发现两个成因，需要采取相反的应对方式。

A residual set of tasks admitted no witness. Examining these one by one, we found two distinct causes that call for opposite responses.

第一种是真实的任务—策略冲突：任务指令本身要求某种资源或位置，但策略禁止了相应操作。有六项任务要求写入只读目录：build-pmars 和 build-pov-ray 要求将二进制文件安装到 /usr/local/bin；build-cython-ext 和 kv-store-grpc 要求将 Python 软件包安装到系统级环境；nginx-request-logging 和 mailman 要求将配置和日志放在 /etc 与 /var 下。第七项任务 count-dataset-tokens 仅因网络策略而无法完成：它要求取得某个 Hugging Face 数据集的确切元数据文件，而该文件只能通过 Hugging Face 自身的端点（huggingface.co 及其内容分发主机）访问，这些端点都不在白名单中。下载 URL 只能经由被阻断的 huggingface.co 请求生成；没有白名单内的镜像，也无法确定性地重新推导该文件。若要接纳这项任务，就必须添加恰恰被固定白名单策略排除的任务专用出站例外。由于任务要求写得很明确，除非修改任务本身，否则不存在可接受的轨迹；我们选择不修改任务，因此报告这些任务在 NIST-derived high 下未解决，而不让它们通过。

The first is a genuine task–policy conflict: the task’s own instruction mandates a resource or location the policy denies. Six tasks pin a write to a read-only tree—build-pmars and build-pov-ray instruct the solver to install a binary to /usr/local/bin; build-cython-ext and kv-store-grpc to install Python packages into the system-wide environment; and nginx-request-logging and mailman to place configuration and logs under /etc and /var. A seventh, count-dataset-tokens, is foreclosed by the network policy alone: it requires the exact metadata file of a Hugging Face dataset, reachable only through Hugging Face’s own endpoints (huggingface.co and its content-delivery hosts), none of which are in the allowlist. The download URL is minted only by the blocked huggingface.co hop, no allowlisted mirror exists, and the file cannot be re-derived deterministically; admitting the task would require exactly the per-task egress exception the fixed-allowlist policy rejects. Because the requirement is written into the task, no admissible trajectory exists without editing the task itself, which we decline to do; these tasks are reported as unsolved under NIST-derived high rather than made to pass.

第二种成因是验证器过度规格化：任务指令允许在没有被拒绝权限的情况下完成，但验证器只检查传统的 root 所有位置，因此把合法的非 root 解标记为失败。sqlite-with-gcov 就是一个例子。任务要求构建 SQLite 并使其能通过 PATH 使用；非 root 智能体在可写工作区中构建软件，并将二进制文件加入自己的 PATH，已经完成了任务，但验证器只从 root 用户的 PATH 中查找 sqlite3，因而报告失败。由于要求的工作确实已经完成，这属于检查机制缺陷，而非解本身的问题。

The second cause is verifier over-specification: the instruction is satisfiable without the denied privilege, but the verifier inspects only the conventional root-owned location and so marks a legitimate non-root solution as failing. sqlite-with-gcov is the illustrative case. The task asks the solver to build SQLite and make it available on the PATH; a non-root agent does exactly that by building under the writable workspace and exposing the binary on its own PATH, yet the verifier resolves sqlite3 only through the root user’s PATH and reports failure. Since the requested work was genuinely performed, this is a deficiency of the check, not of the solution.

增量式验证器修正Additive verifier corrections.

对于过度规格化案例，我们采用刻意不对称的原则：绝不修改任务指令，但可以修正无法识别合法解的验证器，前提是修正只增加一个允许的位置，并保留所有实质性检查。修正后的验证器会在传统位置或智能体可写工作区中查找所需产物，并在所有策略级别上一致应用，确保没有任何一组获得优势。我们为五项任务编写了这种增量式验证器：sqlite-with-gcov、adaptive-rejection-sampler、make-doom-for-mips、mcmc-sampling-stan 和 configure-git-webserver。

For the over-specified cases our operating rule is deliberately asymmetric: we never alter a task’s instruction, but we may correct a verifier that fails to recognize a valid solution, provided the correction only adds an admissible location and preserves every substantive check. The corrected verifier resolves the required artifact at the conventional location or the agent-writable workspace, and is applied uniformly across all policy levels so that no arm gains an advantage. We produced such additive verifiers for five tasks: sqlite-with-gcov, adaptive-rejection-sampler, make-doom-for-mips, mcmc-sampling-stan, and configure-git-webserver.

结果Outcome.

完成上述分析后，89 项任务中有 82 项被确认在 NIST-derived high 下具有可解性见证：其中 50 项使用未修改的参考解，32 项使用自行编写的策略兼容解（表 7）；其中五项只有在上述验证器修正后才能达到通过状态。其余七项是六项任务—策略冲突和 count-dataset-tokens；该项任务的评分问题见附录 C。这个区分对于解释主要数字很重要：在 NIST-derived high 下被计为未解的任务，是按任务自身条件确实被策略阻断，而不是因为合适的验证器没有给予认可。

After this analysis, 82 of the 89 tasks are established to admit a solvability witness under NIST-derived high: for 50 it is the unmodified reference solution, and for 32 an authored policy-compatible one (Table 7), five of which reach the passing state only once the over-specified verifier is corrected as above. The remaining seven are the six task–policy conflicts and count-dataset-tokens, whose scoring artifact is documented in Appendix C. The distinction matters for interpreting the headline numbers: a task counted as unsolved under NIST-derived high is one the policy genuinely forecloses by the task’s own terms, not one an adequate verifier would have credited.

为何可解任务仍会在策略下失败Why solvable tasks still fail under policy

有五项任务需要改编验证器才能认可符合策略的解。它们在 NIST-derived high 下的结果（论文主文表 2）差异很大，成因也值得分析。

Five tasks needed an adapted verifier to admit a policy-compliant solution. Their outcomes under NIST-derived high (Table 2 of the main paper) differ sharply, and the reasons are instructive.

策略移除了什么What the policy removed.

加固并非只在固定计划上增加阻力；它会移除任务原先依赖的假设，而且每个策略维度移除的假设不同。对于 sqlite-with-gcov，它移除了一个目标路径：智能体可以轻松编译 SQLite，但传统安装路径是只读的。对于 mcmc-sampling-stan，它移除了软件来源：智能体能访问的所有 R 软件包渠道都在白名单之外，36 次试验中有 31 次向 CRAN 主镜像请求时收到 HTTP 403，之后智能体不断尝试其他镜像，直到发现某个白名单内的操作系统软件源恰好提供该软件包。对于 configure-git-webserver，它移除了任务所假设的系统架构：随附的参考轨迹会安装系统软件包、创建 UNIX 账户，并以 root 身份运行特权端口上的 SSH 守护进程，这些操作在加固后都无法执行。我们的见证解只能在工作区内重建整套架构，其中包括一个 SSH 服务：它能验证预期的登录身份，却不需要对应的系统账户。

Hardening does not add friction to a fixed plan; it removes an assumption the task was built on, and each axis removes a different one. On sqlite-with-gcov it removes a destination: the agent compiles SQLite without difficulty, but the conventional install path is read-only. On mcmc-sampling-stan it removes supply: every R package channel the agents reach lies outside the allowlist, and in 31 of the 36 trials the request to CRAN’s primary mirrors returns HTTP 403, after which agents work down through further mirrors until they find that an allowlisted operating-system repository happens to carry the package. On configure-git-webserver it removes the architecture the task presumes: the provided reference trajectory installs system packages, creates a UNIX account, and runs a privileged-port SSH daemon as root, none of which survive hardening. Our witness reaches the passing state only by rebuilding that stack inside the workspace, including an SSH service that authenticates the expected login without any corresponding system account.

修复可以找回什么What a repair can recover.

修复只能找回智能体留在可预测位置的成果。对于 sqlite-with-gcov，任务说明本身指定了构建位置，因此智能体和验证器会检查同一位置；修复后找回了大部分分数（改编验证器下为 80.6%，Control 下为 97.2%）。若任务没有指定位置，智能体就会各自采用不同做法，修复便很难找到结果。mcmc-sampling-stan 是最明显的例子：验证器对估计后验均值的检查在除两次以外的所有试验中都通过，表明统计计算已经完成；但每次试验中，启动新的 R 会话的两项检查都失败，因为每个智能体都只让自己的脚本使用自己的软件包目录，未使其他进程能够发现该安装。我们的见证解通过一个小型包装脚本，为任意调用者设置库路径后通过验证。在加固条件下，这些智能体完成了任务要求的工作，但成果仅对自身可见。

A repair recovers only what the agent left somewhere predictable. On sqlite-with-gcov the task statement itself names the build location, so the agent and the verifier look in the same place and the repair recovers most of the score (80.6% under the adapted verifier against 97.2% in control). Where no location is prescribed, agents improvise separately and the repair finds little. mcmc-sampling-stan is the clearest case: the verifier’s own checks on the estimated posterior means pass in all but two trials, so the statistical work was done, while both checks that open a fresh R session fail in every trial, because each agent pointed its own script at its own package directory instead of making the installation discoverable to another process. Our witness passes by writing a small wrapper that sets the library path for any caller. Under hardening these agents completed the requested work but left the result private to themselves.

哪些并非策略影响What is not a policy effect.

在 configure-git-webserver 上，改编后的验证器没有找回任何失败试验的分数；这本身就说明问题并非成果发现失败。make-doom-for-mips 在 Control 下也未被解决，因此它在策略下得零分，并不能说明加固的影响。

On configure-git-webserver the adapted verifier recovers none of the failing trials, which is itself evidence that they are not discovery failures. make-doom-for-mips is unsolved in control as well, so its zero under policy carries no information about hardening.

附录 C：一项基准完整性问题Appendix C: A Benchmark-Integrity Artifact

当官方评分流程无法确认任务要求的工作确实已完成时，我们将该任务标记为基准完整性问题。这类发现不同于普通任务失败，也不同于被策略变为不可解的任务。被标记任务仍保留在所有已报告汇总结果中，与主文按 89 项任务报告的口径一致；标记适用于全部模型—运行框架组合（即模型与运行该模型的智能体框架）和策略级别，受影响的原始试验也保留供审计。

We flag a task as a benchmark-integrity artifact when the official scoring path does not establish that the requested work was performed. Such findings are distinct from ordinary task failures and from tasks that become unsolved under a policy. A flagged task remains in every reported aggregate, consistent with the main paper’s 89-task reporting; the flag is recorded across all model–harness bundles (a model paired with the agent harness that runs it) and policy levels, and the affected raw trials are preserved for audit.

count-dataset-tokenscount-dataset-tokens.

这项任务要求检索一个 Hugging Face 数据集并计算 token 数。在一次受影响的 NIST-derived high 试验中，数据集请求返回 HTTP 403，轨迹中没有成功检索或分词的记录，但模型仍提交了预期的精确常数 79586。官方验证器只检查答案文件中是否出现该字符串，因此给了通过分数。在没有按要求执行计算的情况下得到精确常数，与基准污染或记忆相符，不过轨迹无法证明模型究竟如何得到该值。可以确认的测量缺陷更有限：验证器在没有证据证明所要求工作已完成时仍然判为通过。该模式并非仅发生在一次试验中：此任务有 13 次试验通过提交预期常数而得分（附录 G）。因此，我们将 count-dataset-tokens 标记为基准完整性问题，仍把其试验保留在所有汇总结果中，并保存为审计证据；另外，由于可解性原因，该任务不纳入 82 项任务的见证子集中（附录 B）。

This task requires retrieving a Hugging Face dataset and computing its token count. In an affected NIST-derived high trial, the dataset request returned HTTP 403, and the trajectory contained no successful retrieval or tokenization. The model nevertheless submitted the exact expected constant, 79586. The official verifier awarded success because it checked only whether that string occurred in the answer file. Producing the exact constant without the required computation is consistent with benchmark contamination or memorization, although the trajectory cannot establish how the model obtained it. The confirmed measurement defect is narrower: the verifier awarded success without evidence that the requested work occurred. The pattern is not a single trial: 13 trials of this task pass by submitting the expected constant (Appendix G). We therefore flag count-dataset-tokens as a benchmark-integrity artifact, keep its trials in every reported aggregate, and preserve them as audit evidence; separately, the task is excluded from the 82-task witness pool on solvability grounds (Appendix B).

附录 D：提供方侧安全干预Appendix D: Provider-Side Safety Interventions

本次运行中，有两类提供方侧安全机制介入了运行框架与模型之间：服务层拒绝和厂商回退路由。两者都不属于基准完整性问题，受影响试验仍保留在所有汇总结果中。我们记录这些机制，是因为它们属于已部署模型调用路径的特性，而非运行时策略的特性；任何使用同一路由的组织都会遇到它们。由于每次干预都按试验记录，我们也报告各策略级别下的发生率，并检查这些机制在加固条件下是否比不受限的 Control 更频繁——如果策略造成的拒绝与重试行为使轨迹更容易触发服务层分类器，就可能出现这种情况。

Two kinds of provider-side safety mechanism, serving-layer refusals and vendor fallback routing, intervened between the harness and the model during our runs. Neither is a benchmark-integrity artifact: the affected trials remain in every aggregate. We document them because they are properties of the deployed model route rather than of the runtime policy, and because any organization operating the same route would encounter them. Because every intervention is annotated per trial, we also report incidence by policy level, examining whether these mechanisms fire more often under hardened levels than under the unrestricted control—as would be expected if policy-induced denial-and-retry behavior makes a trajectory more likely to be flagged by a serving-layer classifier.

未获安全授权时的服务层拒绝Serving-layer refusals without security authorization.

OpenAI 的服务层会筛查网络安全风险请求。在涉及安全主题的任务上，它可能以「This content was flagged for possible cybersecurity risk」消息终止模型流，并提示调用者注册 Trusted Access for Cyber 计划。³测量期间，我们的组织尚未注册，因此试验使用默认的未注册服务路径。触发标记后，Codex CLI 会重新连接并重试已断开的流；重试常常能够成功：43 次被标记的试验中，有 25 次恢复了流并完成试验，其中 23 次通过任务。重试耗尽后，CLI 会放弃当前轮次；受影响试验要么在轨迹中途终止（18 次放弃中有 14 次属于这种常见情况），要么在任何工具调用前结束。标记具有随机性：同一任务的某些尝试会被终止，其他完全相同的尝试则能继续。我们不排除这些试验。按照对已部署组合的评估范围，提供方拒绝响应的任务，就是该组合在相应策略级别下的一次失败；它会降低测得成功率，也会产生已消耗尝试的成本。我们根据运行框架事件流检测每次触发（带有该标记消息、并呈现零工作量或轨迹中断特征的终结性 turn.failed 事件），给试验加注标记，并报告这些拒绝的频率，使其对失败次数和成本的影响清晰可见，而不会被默默合并进一般失败。任何未取得此授权的组织都会测量并使用同一受限服务路径；已注册组织则可对经过验证的安全工作使用限制更少的服务路径。

OpenAI’s serving layer screens requests for cybersecurity risk. On security-themed tasks it can terminate the model stream with the message ‘‘This content was flagged for possible cybersecurity risk,’’ directing the caller to enroll in its Trusted Access for Cyber program.3OpenAI Trusted Access for Cyber 计划。3 3 https://openai.com/index/trusted-access-for-cyber/ Our organization was not enrolled during the measurement window, so our runs traverse the default, unenrolled serving route. When the flag fires, the Codex CLI reconnects and retries the disconnected stream, and the retry frequently succeeds: in 25 of the 43 flagged trials the stream resumed and the trial ran to completion, 23 of which reached a passing state. When the retries are exhausted the CLI abandons the turn, and the affected trial either aborts mid-trajectory, which is the common case (14 of the 18 abandoned trials), or terminates before any tool call. The flagging is stochastic—some attempts of a task are terminated while identical sibling attempts proceed. We do not exclude these trials. Under our deployed-bundle scope, a task the provider declines to serve is a failure of that model–harness bundle at that policy level: it depresses the measured success rate and still incurs the cost of the consumed attempts. We detect each occurrence from the harness event stream (a terminal turn.failed carrying the flag message, with a zero-work or aborted-trajectory signature), annotate the trial, and report the frequency of these refusals alongside the affected results, so their contribution to failure counts and cost is visible rather than folded silently into ordinary failures. Any organization without this authorization measures—and operates—the same degraded route; enrolled organizations receive a more permissive serving path for verified security work.

双用途分类器下的厂商回退路由Vendor fallback routing under dual-use classifiers.

Claude Fable 5 配备双用途安全分类器；厂商的生产环境行为是在请求被标记时改由 Claude Opus 4.8 提供响应。⁴我们的运行框架通过在请求级别声明厂商回退来保留这一行为，因此 Fable 5 的结果衡量的是组织实际部署的受门控产品路由。厂商自己的报告披露了这一回退在每个基准上触发的频率（随附系统卡中，Terminal-Bench 试验为 20.9%）；我们采用同样的披露做法：模型网关记录实际响应每个请求的模型，并为每个 Fable 5 结果报告至少包含一次回退响应的试验比例，以及每个试验中由回退模型响应的请求比例。因此，该组合的数字应解读为受门控路由的表现，回退比例则明确指出回退模型参与的频率。在评估的 801 次试验中，27.6% 至少包含一次回退响应，高于厂商对该基准报告的 20.9%；所有请求中有 29.9% 由回退模型响应。分布明显呈双峰：72.4% 的试验完全由 Claude Fable 5 响应，12.9% 完全由 Claude Opus 4.8 响应；不过，多数受回退影响的试验混合使用两个模型，因此回退路由经常、但并非总是贯穿整个对话。

Claude Fable 5 ships with dual-use safety classifiers, and the vendor’s production behavior when a request is flagged is to serve the response with Claude Opus 4.8 instead.4Anthropic 关于 Claude Fable 5 / Mythos 5 的公告。4 4 https://www.anthropic.com/news/claude-fable-5-mythos-5 Our harness preserves this behavior by declaring the vendor’s fallback at the request level, so Fable 5 results measure the gated product route an organization actually deploys. The vendor’s own reporting discloses how often the fallback fires per benchmark (20.9% of Terminal-Bench trials in the accompanying system card), and we adopt the same disclosure practice: the model gateway records the model that actually served every request, and each Fable 5 result is accompanied by the share of trials containing at least one fallback-served completion and the per-trial share of fallback-served requests. Numbers for this bundle should therefore be read as the behavior of the gated route, with the fallback share as the explicit label of how often the fallback model participated. Across the 801 evaluated trials, 27.6% contained at least one fallback-served completion, against the 20.9% of trials the vendor reports for this benchmark, and 29.9% of all requests were served by the fallback model. The distribution is strongly bimodal: 72.4% of trials were served entirely by Claude Fable 5 and 12.9% entirely by Claude Opus 4.8, though a majority of the fallback-touched trials mix both models, so the routing decision often, but not always, persists across a conversation.

重新路由与拒绝是不同结果Rerouting and refusal are distinct outcomes.

上文的回退和拒绝并非同一机制的连续阶段。回退在每次请求中都已声明；当 Claude Fable 5 路由拒绝响应时，请求会重试并转交 Claude Opus 4.8，智能体不会察觉异常。相反，拒绝本身是一次正常成功完成的响应，只是其内容为拒绝信息，因此路由层没有理由重试。protein-assembly 试验清楚展示了这一区别：所有请求都已由 Claude Opus 4.8 响应，回退机制完全启动，但试验仍因 Claude Opus 4.8 拒绝同一内容而结束。这里评估的每个 Claude 模型都会拒绝该任务，因此在它们之间重新路由也无法解决问题。

The fallback and the refusals above are not successive stages of one mechanism. The fallback is declared on every request, and it engages when the Claude Fable 5 route declines to serve one: the request is retried against Claude Opus 4.8 and the agent observes nothing unusual. A refusal, by contrast, arrives as an ordinary successful completion whose content is the refusal itself, which presents the routing layer with nothing to retry. The protein-assembly trials make the distinction concrete: the fallback was fully engaged there, with every request already served by Claude Opus 4.8, and the trial still ended in a refusal because Claude Opus 4.8 refused the same content. That task is refused by every Claude model evaluated here, so rerouting between them cannot resolve it.

Claude Code 路由中的拒绝Refusals on the Claude Code route.

Claude Code 路由中还出现了另外三种拒绝消息，均不会触发重试；每条消息出现时都会结束试验。Claude Opus 5 会返回提及 Anthropic Cyber Verification Program 的网络安全主题拒绝，这是上文 OpenAI 标记机制在结构上的对应物，也是我们观察到的、导致试验终止的干预中数量最多的一种。Claude Opus 4.8 和 Claude Sonnet 5 会返回一般的 Usage Policy 拒绝；Claude Fable 5 会发出提及其双用途分类器的保护提示——前文已描述该分类器的生产回退行为。另有一种措辞提及对违规网络内容的限制，曾在 Claude Opus 5 上出现一次。表 8 列出每种消息及其出现次数和导致试验结束的频率。Usage Policy 消息本身也值得注意：它建议 API 集成方配置回退模型以减少拒绝，这正是上文为 Claude Fable 5 记录的厂商机制。

Three further refusal messages appear on the Claude Code route, none of which is retried: each ends the trial where it fires. Claude Opus 5 returns a cybersecurity-topic refusal naming Anthropic’s Cyber Verification Program, the structural counterpart of the OpenAI flag above and the single largest source of trial-ending interventions we observe. Claude Opus 4.8 and Claude Sonnet 5 return a general Usage Policy refusal, and Claude Fable 5 returns a safeguard notice naming its own dual-use classifiers, the classifiers whose production fallback behavior the preceding paragraph describes. A fourth wording, citing restrictions on violative cyber content, appeared once on Claude Opus 5. Table 8 gives each message with its frequency and how often it ended the trial. The Usage Policy message is itself instructive: it advises API integrators to configure a fallback model to reduce refusals, which is exactly the vendor mechanism documented above for Claude Fable 5.

各策略级别的发生率Incidence by policy level.

这些干预没有因加固而变得更频繁。五个受影响组合在 Control 下记录到 28 次被标记试验，在 non-root 下为 41 次，在 NIST-derived high 下为 29 次（表 9）。五个组合中有四个在三种条件下基本持平；只有 Claude Opus 5 出现明显变化，其 non-root 下 20 次标记中有 12 次出现在设计上受阻的任务上；在这些任务上，智能体必须先尝试被策略禁止的特权操作才能继续。因此，我们没有观察到该机制所预期的关联，也不作此类报告。次数较少，且集中在特定组合和任务上，因此我们只描述这些结果，不进行检验。

These interventions do not become more frequent under hardening. The five affected bundles recorded 28 flagged trials under control, 41 under non-root, and 29 under NIST-derived high (Table 9). Four of the five are flat across the three conditions; only Claude Opus 5 varies materially, and 12 of its 20 non-root flags fall on tasks that are blocked by design, where the agent must attempt the privileged operations the policy denies before it can make progress. We therefore do not observe the association the mechanism would predict, and we report none. The counts are small and clustered by bundle and by task, so we describe them rather than test them.

任务集中度Task concentration.

这些标记反映的是任务内容。98 次干预全部落在 89 项任务中的 16 项上，其中四项任务占了略低于一半：vulnerable-secret（18 次试验）、protein-assembly（12 次）、break-filter-js-from-html（9 次）和 feal-differential-cryptanalysis（9 次）。vulnerable-secret 会触发两家厂商的分类器，且在每种策略条件和每次重复中都会触发；protein-assembly 是蛋白质设计任务，只触发 Anthropic 侧的拒绝。导致试验结束的 73 次干预中，有 70 次被评分为失败：19 次发生在设计上受阻的任务上，51 次发生在具有可解性见证的任务上（附录 B）。只有后 51 次可能代表成功率损失；若策略下任务本身受阻，前 19 次无论如何都不可能通过。在 Control 下，策略不会封锁任何任务，代价较小且有明确上限：五个受影响组合的 1,335 次 Control 试验中有 18 次（1.3%）以干预导致的失败告终；单个组合最多为 267 次 Control 试验中的 6 次，因此没有组合的 Control 成功率下降超过 2.2 个百分点。我们将这一划分作为观察结果记录，而非排除试验的理由：两组试验都保留在汇总结果中。

What the flags track is task content. All 98 fall on 16 of the 89 tasks, and four tasks account for just under half of them: vulnerable-secret (18 trials), protein-assembly (12), break-filter-js-from-html (9), and feal-differential-cryptanalysis (9). vulnerable-secret draws both vendors’ classifiers, in every policy condition and every replicate; protein-assembly, a protein-design task, draws only Anthropic-side refusals. Of the 73 interventions that ended a trial, 70 were scored as failures: 19 fall on tasks that are blocked by design and 51 on tasks for which a solvability witness exists (Appendix B). Only the 51 could represent lost successes; the 19 that fall on blocked-by-design tasks could not have passed under the policy regardless. Under control, where the policy forecloses no task, the cost is small and bounded: 18 of the 1,335 control trials across the five affected bundles (1.3%) ended in an intervention-caused failure, at most 6 of a single bundle’s 267 control trials, so no bundle’s control success rate is depressed by more than 2.2 percentage points. We record that split as an observation, not as grounds for exclusion: neither group is removed from the reported aggregates.

附录 E：软件版本Appendix E: Software Versions

表 10 列出了生成论文所有结果所用的软件。除 Claude Opus 5 使用的 Claude Code 版本（在本附录末尾说明）外，所有组件都在基准运行前冻结，并在不同模型、策略和重复试验中保持不变。发布的产物固定了完整的传递依赖闭包：评估控制器使用 uv.lock；沙箱内 Terminus-2 运行时使用完全锁定哈希的 requirements.lock（通过 uv pip compile --generate-hashes --universal 生成，并采用 --exclude-newer 截止日期 2026-07-15）。

Table 10 lists the software used to produce every result in the paper. All components were frozen before the benchmark runs and held fixed across models, policies, and repetitions; the single exception (the Claude Code version used for Claude Opus 5) is documented at the end of this appendix. The complete transitive dependency closure is pinned in the released artifact: uv.lock for the evaluation controller and a fully hash-pinned requirements.lock for the in-sandbox Terminus-2 runtime (generated with uv pip compile --generate-hashes --universal and an --exclude-newer horizon of 2026-07-15).

沙箱环境Sandbox environments.

每次试验都会根据任务自身的 Terminal-Bench 2.1 Docker 镜像创建一个全新的 Daytona 云沙箱，镜像严格遵循任务 task.toml 中声明的 environment.docker_image；CPU、内存和存储遵循任务规定，不作覆盖。任务镜像并不相同，包含基于 glibc 和 musl 的不同发行版；因此，基础镜像软件包版本由按摘要固定的数据集确定，而非由一组全局版本号确定。每个沙箱在启动时安装一层运行环境：发行版基础软件包、指定版本的运行框架命令行工具（Claude Code 使用官方安装器；Codex 和 uv 使用版本固定的 GitHub 发布二进制；Grok 来自版本固定的制品桶；Terminus-2 使用哈希锁定的 requirements.lock），以及策略执行栈。

Each trial provisions a fresh Daytona cloud sandbox from the task’s own per-task Terminal-Bench 2.1 Docker image, exactly as declared in the task’s task.toml (environment.docker_image); CPU, memory, and storage follow the task’s declared resources without override. Task images are heterogeneous (a mix of glibc- and musl-based distributions), so base-image package versions are fixed by the digest-pinned dataset rather than by a single global pin. A runtime layer is installed into every sandbox at run start: distribution base packages, the harness CLI at the pinned version above (Claude Code via its official installer, Codex and uv as pinned GitHub release binaries, Grok from a pinned artifact bucket, Terminus-2 from the hash-pinned requirements.lock), and the policy enforcement stack.

策略执行栈Policy enforcement stack.

策略加固使用在沙箱内配置的 Linux 内核机制：按 UID 限定、采用拒绝规则的 nftables 防火墙，并强制通过出站代理（以仓库内仅依赖 Python 标准库的代码实现）；seccomp 过滤器和 LD_PRELOAD 替代库在沙箱内使用任务镜像自带的工具链和 libseccomp 编译，以便链接到该镜像的 libc；此外还使用 Landlock 网络规则。执行机制源码属于冻结仓库的一部分；用户空间库版本（libseccomp、nftables）遵循各任务镜像中固定的发行版软件包版本。

Policy hardening uses Linux kernel mechanisms configured from within the sandbox: a uid-scoped nftables reject wall with a forced egress proxy (implemented in-repo in stdlib-only Python), seccomp filters and LD_PRELOAD shims compiled in-sandbox with the task image’s own toolchain and libseccomp so they link against that image’s libc, and Landlock network rules. The enforcement source is part of the frozen repository; the userspace library versions (libseccomp, nftables) follow each task image’s pinned distribution packages.

模型服务Model serving.

所有模型推理都通过 OpenRouter HTTP API 提供，并使用与运行框架对应的厂商端点（如实验设置所述）。OpenRouter 是托管服务；除上文列出的 openai 客户端版本外，没有其他客户端版本固定项。发布的实验溯源记录了每个模型组合使用的确切提供方模型标识符。

All model inference is served over the OpenRouter HTTP API with per-harness vendor endpoints (as described in the experimental setup); OpenRouter is a hosted service and carries no client-side version pin beyond the openai client version listed above. The released experiment provenance records the exact provider model identifier for every bundle.

Claude Opus 5 使用的 Claude Code 版本Claude Code version for Claude Opus 5

Claude Sonnet 5、Claude Fable 5 和 Claude Opus 4.8 使用 Claude Code 2.1.206 评估，这是原始基准运行时冻结的运行框架版本。Claude Opus 5 则在这些运行完成后才发布。若仅为容纳这一个新增模型，就将之前评估过的每个组合都用较新的运行框架重跑，成本会很高，也会扰动冻结的配置，因此我们对 Opus 5 采用范围严格受限的例外。上游 Claude Code 直到 v2.1.219 才识别 claude-opus-5 模型标识符；⁵因此我们使用紧接其后的版本 Claude Code 2.1.220 评估 Opus 5，该版本只包含可靠性修复。在 v2.1.206 下，Opus 5 请求会在客户端和协议层失败，智能体无法收到任何可用模型响应；我们将这些观察视为运行框架不兼容，而非模型结果，并予以排除。其他 Claude 模型没有改用 v2.1.206 以外的版本，因此历史运行框架配置其余部分保持不变；版本例外及受影响运行均记录在发布的实验溯源资料中。

Claude Sonnet 5, Claude Fable 5, and Claude Opus 4.8 were evaluated with Claude Code 2.1.206, the harness version frozen for the original benchmark runs. Claude Opus 5 was released only after those runs had completed. Re-running every previously evaluated bundle on a newer harness solely to accommodate one added model would have been costly and would have perturbed the frozen configuration, so we instead admitted Opus 5 as a narrowly scoped exception. Upstream Claude Code did not recognize the claude-opus-5 model identifier until v2.1.219,5Claude Code 发布记录。5 5 https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/blob/main/feed.xml so we evaluated Opus 5 with Claude Code 2.1.220, the immediately following release, which contributed only reliability fixes. Under v2.1.206, Opus 5 requests failed at the client and protocol level before the agent received any usable model response; we treat those observations as harness incompatibilities rather than model outcomes and exclude them. No other Claude model was moved off v2.1.206, so the historical harness configuration is otherwise unchanged, and the version exception and the affected runs are recorded in the released experiment provenance.

提供方模型标识符Provider model identifiers

表 11 列出了十二种受测模型各自用于推理的确切提供方模型标识符，以及负责调用该模型的智能体运行框架。每个标识符都是传给 OpenRouter HTTP API 的字符串，并与发布的实验溯源中对应组合所记录的值相同。主要比较中，运行框架按厂商类别固定：Anthropic 模型使用 Claude Code，OpenAI 模型使用 Codex，Grok 4.5 使用 Grok Build，所有开放权重模型使用 Terminus-2。

Table 11 lists, for each of the twelve evaluated models, the exact provider model identifier used for inference and the agent harness that drove it. Every identifier is the string passed to the OpenRouter HTTP API; it is the same value recorded in the released experiment provenance for every result bundle. In the primary comparison, harness assignment is fixed per vendor family: the Anthropic models run under Claude Code, the OpenAI models under Codex, Grok 4.5 under Grok Build, and all open-weight models under Terminus-2.

附录 F：各策略下逐组合的完整结果Appendix F: Full Per-Bundle Results under Policy

表 12 和表 13 给出了主文图 1 背后的逐组合成功率和成本，涵盖各模型—运行框架组合在每种策略下的结果。表 12 使用图中所示的完整 89 项任务池；表 13 则限制为在 NIST-derived high 下具有可解性见证的 82 项任务（附录 B），排除七项在设计上受阻的任务。成功率是通过试验比例，附带三次重复的标准差；成本是任务池上的平均重复成本，单位为美元；未报告重复试验间的成本离散程度。

Tables 12 and 13 give the per-bundle success rate and cost behind Figure 1 of the main paper, for every model–harness bundle under each policy. Table 12 is the full 89-task pool as plotted; Table 13 restricts to the 82 tasks that admit a solvability witness under NIST-derived high (Appendix B), excluding the seven blocked-by-design tasks. Success rate is the percentage of passing trials with the standard deviation across the three repetitions; cost is the mean replicate cost over the pool, in US dollars; cost dispersion across the repetitions is not reported.

帕累托前沿成员Pareto frontier membership

表 14 根据表 13 计算了 NIST-derived high 下、82 项见证任务池的成功率—成本帕累托前沿：若没有其他组合能以不高于该组合的成本达到至少相同的成功率，该组合就在前沿上。共有三个组合不受支配。GPT-5.6 Sol 和 Grok 4.5 的成功率同为 79.3%，但 Sol 的成本为 51.67 美元，低于 Grok 的 75.64 美元；因此 Sol 支配 Grok，Grok 4.5 作为成本更高者退出前沿。

Table 14 reports the success–cost Pareto frontier under NIST-derived high on the 82-task witnessed pool, computed from Table 13: a bundle lies on the frontier when no other bundle reaches at least its success rate at no greater cost. Three bundles are non-dominated. GPT-5.6 Sol and Grok 4.5 tie at 79.3%79.3\% success, but Sol attains it at $51.67 to Grok’s $75.64, so Sol dominates Grok, and Grok 4.5 leaves the frontier as the costlier of the two.

附录 G：阻断动作分析Appendix G: Blocked-Action Analysis

本附录详细说明主文结果中的阻断动作分析：统计单位与证据、完整证据筛选条件、各策略维度和任务的细节，以及阻断与结果之间的关联。全部数字基于完整评测群体（十二个组合、89 项任务、每种条件下三次试验），通过对每次试验所存证据进行确定性、与结果无关的重新分析得到。

This appendix details the blocked-action analysis behind the main paper’s Results: the unit and its evidence, the verified-evidence gate, per-axis and per-task detail, and the association with outcomes. All numbers are computed over the full evaluated cohort (twelve bundles, 89 tasks, three trials per condition) by a deterministic, outcome-blind re-analysis of each trial’s stored evidence.

统计单位与证据类别Unit and evidence classes.

一个阻断动作是一次被拒绝的操作。底层记录中有两类证据参与计数，且彼此区分：由执行机制记录的阻断（出站代理拒绝、防火墙计数器和 sudo 日志），以及从轨迹文本推断的拒绝（EROFS、EPERM、HTTP 403、连接被拒和 DNS 失败等特征性错误）。同一被拒操作产生的重复错误输出会合并为一次；若推断出的拒绝只是重复记录同一维度上已由执行机制观测到的阻断，则不会再次计数。计数过程不会读取验证器结果，因此下文对结果的关联分析不是循环论证。

A blocked action is one denied operation. Two evidence classes contribute and remain distinct in the underlying records: enforcement-observed blocks, logged by the enforcement mechanisms themselves (the egress proxy’s denials, firewall counters, and the sudo log), and transcript-inferred denials, recognized from characteristic error signatures in the transcript (EROFS, EPERM, HTTP 403, refused connections, DNS failures). Repeated error output from one denied operation is collapsed to a single action, and an inferred denial that merely echoes an enforcement-observed block on the same axis is not counted again. The counter never reads the verifier outcome, so the outcome associations below are not circular.

已验证证据筛选Verified-evidence gate.

当轨迹文本超过存储上限时，存储记录会被截断。截断记录仍可能显示发生了阻断，但无法证明没有阻断，因此所有计数只使用证据已确认完整的试验：总计 9,612 次试验中的 6,194 次；在 NIST-derived high 下，则为 3,204 次中的 2,051 次，覆盖 89 项任务中的 88 项。各条件下的截断比例相近（35%–36%），因此筛选不会偏向某个条件；但不同运行框架的截断比例不均（Grok 4.5 组合的 801 次试验中只有 213 次记录完整），任务之间也不同：schemelike-metacircular-eval 在几乎所有条件的几乎所有试验中都会超过上限，包括 Control，因此我们保守地将其排除在可评估任务之外；它的轨迹只是很长（NIST-derived high 下 36 次试验中有 26 次通过）。所有总数都是下界。

A stored trace is truncated when a transcript exceeds its storage bound. A truncated trace can still show blocked actions, but it cannot establish their absence, so every count uses only trials whose evidence is verified complete: 6,194 of 9,612 trials overall, and under NIST-derived high 2,051 of 3,204, covering 88 of the 89 tasks. Truncation is flat across conditions (35–36% of trials at every policy level), so the gate does not tilt cross-condition comparisons; it is uneven across harnesses (the Grok 4.5 bundle retains 213 of 801 trials) and tasks: schemelike-metacircular-eval exceeds the bound in nearly every trial in every condition, including control, and is conservatively excluded from the evaluable set; its transcripts are simply long (it passes 26 of its 36 trials under NIST-derived high). All totals are lower bounds.

维度与重复发生Axes and persistence.

阻断动作恰好落在各条件限制的维度上：包括轨迹被截断的试验在内，Control 下全部 3,204 次试验都记录为零；non-root 下的 482 次阻断全部是权限拒绝。NIST-derived high 下，拒绝总量为出站访问 5,250 次、权限 392 次、文件系统 158 次（出站访问占 5,800 次总量的 90.5%）；但发生过拒绝的试验数差距较小：出站访问 500 次、权限 283 次、文件系统 158 次。权限拒绝影响的任务数比出站访问更多（60 项，对比 55 项）。总计 2,051 次证据完整的试验中有 675 次至少发生了一次阻断；由于同一试验可能在多个维度遭遇拒绝，因此这个并集小于各维度发生次数之和 941。总量上的差距来自反复尝试：遇到出站访问限制的试验平均记录 10.5 次拒绝，权限拒绝为 1.4 次，文件系统拒绝恰为一次。单次试验最多出现 171 次出站拒绝。按目的地关联（归因属于启发式）后，62% 的出站拒绝量被归为在同一试验中对早先已被阻断目的地的重复尝试；对单一目的地最多重复尝试 86 次。重复尝试证明智能体持续请求某个目的地，但不能说明其意图：有意重试和客户端库自动重试无法区分（软件包安装器默认会重试其主机）。与可重试性的解释一致，最终呈现为 EROFS 或 EPERM 的拒绝完全没有重复尝试。

Blocked actions land exactly on the axes each condition restricts: control records zero across all 3,204 trials, including those with truncated traces, and all 482 blocked actions under non-root are privilege denials. Under NIST-derived high the volume split is 5,250 egress, 392 privilege, and 158 filesystem denials (egress is 90.5% of the 5,800 total), but incidence is closer than volume: 500 trials record an egress denial, 283 a privilege denial, 158 a filesystem denial, and privilege denials touch more tasks than egress denials (60 against 55). In total, 675 of the 2,051 verified trials record at least one blocked action; this union is smaller than the per-axis incidence sum (941) because a trial can be denied on more than one axis. The volume gap is persistence. A trial that hits the egress wall records 10.5 denials on average, against 1.4 for privilege and exactly one for filesystem; single trials reach 171 egress denials, and destination-level linking, whose attribution is heuristic, assigns 62% of egress volume to re-attempts against a destination already blocked earlier in the same trial, up to 86 re-attempts on one destination. A re-attempt establishes pressure on a destination, not intent: a deliberate retry is indistinguishable from a client library’s automatic retry (package installers retry their host by default). Consistent with a retryability reading, the denials that present as final (EROFS, EPERM) show no re-attempts at all.

跨任务集中度Concentration across tasks.

在 88 项可评估任务中，14 项记录到已验证的零次阻断，48 项（包括这 14 项）总共不超过五次阻断；而前五项任务占全部阻断量的 52.8%：build-pov-ray（693 次）、break-filter-js-from-html（685 次）、mteb-retrieve（596 次）、protein-assembly（555 次）和 count-dataset-tokens（534 次）；前十二项任务占 80%。有七项任务在每次证据完整的试验中都出现阻断：build-pmars、build-pov-ray、count-dataset-tokens、hf-model-inference、make-doom-for-mips、mteb-retrieve 和 protein-assembly。表 15 给出分布；总数包含重复尝试，而重复尝试只会增加计数，因此低阻断区间中的任务数是保守估计。

Of the 88 evaluable tasks, 14 record a verified zero and 48, including those 14, record five or fewer blocked actions in total, while the top five carry 52.8% of all volume: build-pov-ray (693), break-filter-js-from-html (685), mteb-retrieve (596), protein-assembly (555), and count-dataset-tokens (534); the top twelve carry 80%. Seven tasks record a blocked action in every verified trial: build-pmars, build-pov-ray, count-dataset-tokens, hf-model-inference, make-doom-for-mips, mteb-retrieve, and protein-assembly. Table 15 gives the distribution; totals include re-attempts, which only inflate counts, so membership in the low buckets is conservative.

遭遇阻断的比例随可解性而变Exposure follows solvability.

按任务可解状态分组（附录 B）：在 49 项可评估、且其随附参考解在策略下仍可用的任务上（附录 B 的 50 项减去 schemelike-metacircular-eval），1,107 次试验中有 14.4% 记录了阻断动作（每次试验 0.95 次）；在需要自行编写见证解的 32 项任务上，764 次试验中有 51.6% 记录了阻断（每次试验 3.81 次）；在设计上受阻的 7 项任务上，180 次试验中有 67.8% 记录了阻断（每次试验 10.18 次）。这一梯度对证据筛选稳健：若计入轨迹被截断的试验，比例分别为 15.2%、54.9% 和 69.8%。

Grouping tasks by their solvability status (Appendix B): on the 49 evaluable tasks whose shipped reference solution survives the policy (the 50 of Appendix B minus schemelike-metacircular-eval), 14.4% of 1,107 trials record a blocked action (0.95 per trial); on the 32 tasks that required an authored witness, 51.6% of 764 trials (3.81 per trial); on the 7 tasks blocked by design, 67.8% of 180 trials (10.18 per trial). The gradient is robust to the evidence gate: with truncated-trace trials included it reads 15.2%, 54.9%, and 69.8%.

与结果的关联Association with outcomes.

在具有可解性见证的任务上，没有阻断动作的试验通过率为 66.2%，至少有一次阻断的试验通过率为 46.7%；失败试验记录的阻断次数是通过试验的 2.7 倍（5.88 次，对比 2.20 次）。在参考解兼容的任务上，通过率差距仍存在（80.5%，对比 59.1%），但阻断量关系反转（通过试验平均 1.04 次，失败试验为 0.67 次）：在这些任务上，遇到限制只是伴随现象，失败大多并非由阻断造成。在设计上受阻的任务中，没有任何证据完整的试验通过；count-dataset-tokens 的 13 次试验例外，它们正是附录 C 所记录的验证器问题。独立分析再次识别出同一任务，印证了标签和证据。这些都只是诊断性关联，而非因果关系：阻断证据本身无法证明试验失败的原因；较难的任务既更常遭遇阻断，也更常失败；而预先意识到策略、从不尝试被拒操作的智能体不会留下任何阻断证据。

On witness tasks, trials with no blocked action pass 66.2% against 46.7% for trials with at least one, and failing trials record 2.7 times the blocked actions of passing trials (5.88 against 2.20). On reference-compatible tasks the pass gap persists (80.5% against 59.1%) but the volume relation inverts (passing trials average 1.04 against 0.67): there, hitting a wall is incidental, and failures are mostly not blockage-shaped. On blocked-by-design tasks no verified trial passes, except 13 trials of count-dataset-tokens, precisely the verifier artifact documented in Appendix C; that this analysis independently isolates the same task corroborates both the labels and the evidence. All of these are diagnostic associations, not causes: blockage evidence alone cannot establish why a trial failed, harder tasks are both more blocked and more failed, and an agent that anticipates the policy and never attempts a denied operation leaves no evidence at all.
